CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.guard_header_native_reference_publication()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN

 -- STANDARD27_BRANCH_BEGIN
 IF NEW.inventory_mode='DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' AND (current_setting('role') IN ('erp_unified27_initializer_2393dbc6db9581c2','erp_unified27_importer_2393dbc6db9581c2')
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT'
      AND after_values->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1'
      AND source_name=NEW.source_name AND source_hash=NEW.source_hash)) THEN
  DECLARE a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE;
 b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; item jsonb; expected jsonb; proof jsonb;
 actual_ids jsonb; claimed_ids jsonb; pointer jsonb; phase_name text; intent_count bigint;
BEGIN
    PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
    IF NEW.mapping_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1'
      OR NEW.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
      OR NEW.history_actual_counts IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_validation_passed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_PROFILE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1'
      AND inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE' AND status='IMPORTED'
      AND source_name=NEW.source_name AND source_hash=NEW.source_hash AND cutoff_at=NEW.cutoff_at;
    SELECT aa.* INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change aa JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt rr ON rr.id=aa.operation_id
      WHERE rr.target_type='IMPORT' AND rr.target_id=b.id AND rr.action='IMPORT_INITIALIZE_CURRENT_ADMIN'
      AND rr.status='COMMITTED' AND rr.result_data->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      AND aa.object_type='IMPORT' AND aa.object_id=b.id AND aa.action=rr.action
      AND aa.actor_account_id=rr.actor_account_id AND aa.occurred_at=rr.completed_at;
    IF a.after_values->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->'payload'->>'document_batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->'payload'->'expected_documents' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.checkpoint->'expected'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_hash THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_INITIAL_PLAN_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
      -- Stage is inserted before its receipt/audit. Only immutable INITIALIZE
      -- plan authorizes this exact identity; existing deferred validator closes it.
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,NULL,TG_OP,false);
    ELSE

    PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
    SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT'
      AND after_values->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change root_a WHERE root_a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND root_a.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint) OR (object_id=NEW.id AND new_version=(NEW.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer+1));
    IF a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' THEN PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_context_v2((a.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation')::uuid); END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=a.operation_id
      AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
    phase_name:=a.after_values->>'phase';
    IF phase_name IS NULL OR phase_name NOT IN ('MASTER','DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH')
      OR a.id IS DISTINCT FROM r.id OR a.actor_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.actor_account_id
      OR a.object_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id OR r.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'IMPORT'
      OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM r.action OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMMITTED'
      OR r.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'IMPORT_PUBLISH' ELSE 'IMPORT_CHUNK' END)
      OR r.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM transaction_timestamp() OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at
      OR r.result_data->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR r.result_data->>'phase' IS DISTINCT FROM phase_name
      OR a.after_values->>'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_SOURCE'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM r.request_key
      OR r.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(
        (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'PUBLISH' ELSE phase_name END)||':'||(a.after_values->'request')::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
      OR jsonb_typeof(a.after_values->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_typeof(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u JOIN naijue_erp.staff s ON s.id=u.staff_id
        LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.hall h ON h.id=s.hall_id WHERE u.id=r.actor_account_id AND u.login_enabled
        AND s.role='ADMIN' AND s.employment_status='在职' AND (s.hall_id IS NULL OR h.enabled)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_OPERATION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=r.target_id;
    IF a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR (a.after_values->'request'->>'cutoff_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM b.cutoff_at
      OR r.result_data->>'packageManifestSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR r.result_data->>'planSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a.after_values->'request'->>'plan_sha256'
      OR a.new_version IS DISTINCT FROM (a.after_values->'checkpoint'->>'sequence')::integer+1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_TARGET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->>'id' ORDER BY value->>'id'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records');
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO claimed_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds');
    IF actual_ids IS DISTINCT FROM claimed_ids OR jsonb_array_length(actual_ids)=0
      OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(actual_ids))<>jsonb_array_length(actual_ids) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_RECORD_SET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records') LOOP
      SELECT decision_reason::jsonb INTO pointer FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_CURRENT_RECORD_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      IF pointer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('format','STANDARD_IMPORT_POINTER_V1','code','SOURCE_BOUND','operationId',r.id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_EXACT_POINTER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      proof:=naijue_erp.standard_import_record_proof((item->>'id')::uuid);
      IF proof->'current_operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
        OR proof->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text OR proof->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_RECORD_PROOF_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;

      IF phase_name NOT IN ('DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH') OR r.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
        OR a.after_values->'checkpoint' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.checkpoint
        OR a.before_values IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.checkpoint
        OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_PREPARED_TRANSITION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,to_jsonb(OLD),TG_OP,NOT(a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND NEW.status='VALIDATING'));
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END;
 END IF;
 -- STANDARD27_BRANCH_END
  IF NEW.inventory_mode='DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' THEN
    IF NEW.mapping_version<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1' OR NEW.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=NEW.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'standard conversion cannot enter the legacy raw/history publication pipeline' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.mapping_version <> 'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' OR NEW.status <> 'IMPORTED' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header h
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
      ('所属厅来源编号','HALL',h.hall_id),('客户来源编号','CUSTOMER',h.customer_id),
      ('营业员来源编号','STAFF',h.salesperson_id),('原创建厅编号','HALL',h.created_hall_id)
    ) v(field,entity,native_id)
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->v.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field='' AND v.native_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field<>'' AND (v.native_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id
          AND r.entity_type=v.entity AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field
          AND COALESCE(r.native_hall_id,r.native_customer_id,r.native_staff_id)=v.native_id))))
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->'原创建厅编号') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号'='' AND h.created_hall_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号'<>'' AND (h.created_hall_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id AND r.entity_type='HALL'
          AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号' AND r.native_hall_id=h.created_hall_id))))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical header has incomplete same-batch native reference coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'仓库来源编号'::text AS field,h.warehouse_id AS native_id FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header h
      UNION ALL SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'调出仓来源编号',h.from_warehouse_id FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
      UNION ALL SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'调入仓来源编号',h.to_warehouse_id FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
    ) h JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->h.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR s.normalized_fields->>h.field='' OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record r WHERE r.import_batch_id=NEW.id
          AND r.source_entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.target_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.status='IMPORTED'
          AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>h.field AND r.target_id=h.native_id))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical header warehouse lacks exact same-batch imported identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Do not let direct source-only inserts evade relation coverage by omitting
  -- the directory row altogether. Writer atomicity is not a publication proof.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row s WHERE s.batch_id=NEW.id
      AND s.entity_type IN ('HALL','CUSTOMER','STAFF') AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=s.batch_id
          AND r.source_row_id=s.id AND r.entity_type=s.entity_type AND r.source_key=s.source_key)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical native dictionary source lacks exact reference directory coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Cover nonempty relations in the directory's own original dictionary rows.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference d
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=d.batch_id AND s.id=d.source_row_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT '默认客户来源编号'::text AS field,'CUSTOMER'::text AS entity,'default_customer_id'::text AS native_column WHERE d.entity_type='HALL'
      UNION ALL SELECT '默认销货仓来源编号','WAREHOUSE','default_sales_warehouse_id' WHERE d.entity_type='HALL'
      UNION ALL SELECT '所属厅来源编号','HALL','hall_id' WHERE d.entity_type='STAFF'
    ) v
    WHERE d.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->v.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field='' AND d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field<>'' AND (d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column IS NULL
        OR (v.entity='WAREHOUSE' AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record r WHERE r.import_batch_id=NEW.id
            AND r.source_entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.target_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.status='IMPORTED'
            AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field AND r.target_id::text=d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column))
        OR (v.entity<>'WAREHOUSE' AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id
            AND r.entity_type=v.entity AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field
            AND COALESCE(r.native_hall_id,r.native_customer_id,r.native_staff_id)::text=d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column)))))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical native directory has incomplete original relation coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_hash THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_INITIAL_PLAN_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
      -- Stage is inserted before its receipt/audit. Only immutable INITIALIZE
      -- plan authorizes this exact identity; existing deferred validator closes it.
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,NULL,TG_OP,false);
    ELSE

    PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
    SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT'
      AND after_values->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change root_a WHERE root_a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND root_a.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint) OR (object_id=NEW.id AND new_version=(NEW.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer+1));
    IF a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' THEN PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_context_v2((a.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation')::uuid); END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=a.operation_id
      AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
    phase_name:=a.after_values->>'phase';
    IF phase_name IS NULL OR phase_name NOT IN ('MASTER','DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH')
      OR a.id IS DISTINCT FROM r.id OR a.actor_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.actor_account_id
      OR a.object_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id OR r.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'IMPORT'
      OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM r.action OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMMITTED'
      OR r.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'IMPORT_PUBLISH' ELSE 'IMPORT_CHUNK' END)
      OR r.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM transaction_timestamp() OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at
      OR r.result_data->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR r.result_data->>'phase' IS DISTINCT FROM phase_name
      OR a.after_values->>'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_SOURCE'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM r.request_key
      OR r.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(
        (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'PUBLISH' ELSE phase_name END)||':'||(a.after_values->'request')::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
      OR jsonb_typeof(a.after_values->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_typeof(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u JOIN naijue_erp.staff s ON s.id=u.staff_id
        LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.hall h ON h.id=s.hall_id WHERE u.id=r.actor_account_id AND u.login_enabled
        AND s.role='ADMIN' AND s.employment_status='在职' AND (s.hall_id IS NULL OR h.enabled)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_OPERATION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=r.target_id;
    IF a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR (a.after_values->'request'->>'cutoff_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM b.cutoff_at
      OR r.result_data->>'packageManifestSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR r.result_data->>'planSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a.after_values->'request'->>'plan_sha256'
      OR a.new_version IS DISTINCT FROM (a.after_values->'checkpoint'->>'sequence')::integer+1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_TARGET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->>'id' ORDER BY value->>'id'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records');
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO claimed_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds');
    IF actual_ids IS DISTINCT FROM claimed_ids OR jsonb_array_length(actual_ids)=0
      OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(actual_ids))<>jsonb_array_length(actual_ids) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_RECORD_SET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records') LOOP
      SELECT decision_reason::jsonb INTO pointer FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_CURRENT_RECORD_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      IF pointer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('format','STANDARD_IMPORT_POINTER_V1','code','SOURCE_BOUND','operationId',r.id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_EXACT_POINTER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      proof:=naijue_erp.standard_import_record_proof((item->>'id')::uuid);
      IF proof->'current_operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
        OR proof->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text OR proof->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_RECORD_PROOF_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;

      IF phase_name NOT IN ('DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH') OR r.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
        OR a.after_values->'checkpoint' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.checkpoint
        OR a.before_values IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.checkpoint
        OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_PREPARED_TRANSITION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,to_jsonb(OLD),TG_OP,NOT(a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND NEW.status='VALIDATING'));
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END;
 END IF;
 -- STANDARD27_BRANCH_END
  IF NEW.inventory_mode='DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' THEN
    IF NEW.mapping_version<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1' OR NEW.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=NEW.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'standard conversion cannot enter the legacy raw/history publication pipeline' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.mapping_version <> 'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' OR NEW.status <> 'IMPORTED' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header h
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
      ('所属厅来源编号','HALL',h.hall_id),('客户来源编号','CUSTOMER',h.customer_id),
      ('营业员来源编号','STAFF',h.salesperson_id),('原创建厅编号','HALL',h.created_hall_id)
    ) v(field,entity,native_id)
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->v.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field='' AND v.native_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field<>'' AND (v.native_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id
          AND r.entity_type=v.entity AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field
          AND COALESCE(r.native_hall_id,r.native_customer_id,r.native_staff_id)=v.native_id))))
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->'原创建厅编号') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号'='' AND h.created_hall_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号'<>'' AND (h.created_hall_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id AND r.entity_type='HALL'
          AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>'原创建厅编号' AND r.native_hall_id=h.created_hall_id))))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical header has incomplete same-batch native reference coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'仓库来源编号'::text AS field,h.warehouse_id AS native_id FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header h
      UNION ALL SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'调出仓来源编号',h.from_warehouse_id FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
      UNION ALL SELECT h.batch_id,h.source_row_id,'调入仓来源编号',h.to_warehouse_id FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h
    ) h JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=h.batch_id AND s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->h.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR s.normalized_fields->>h.field='' OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record r WHERE r.import_batch_id=NEW.id
          AND r.source_entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.target_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.status='IMPORTED'
          AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>h.field AND r.target_id=h.native_id))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical header warehouse lacks exact same-batch imported identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Do not let direct source-only inserts evade relation coverage by omitting
  -- the directory row altogether. Writer atomicity is not a publication proof.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row s WHERE s.batch_id=NEW.id
      AND s.entity_type IN ('HALL','CUSTOMER','STAFF') AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=s.batch_id
          AND r.source_row_id=s.id AND r.entity_type=s.entity_type AND r.source_key=s.source_key)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical native dictionary source lacks exact reference directory coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Cover nonempty relations in the directory's own original dictionary rows.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference d
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=d.batch_id AND s.id=d.source_row_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT '默认客户来源编号'::text AS field,'CUSTOMER'::text AS entity,'default_customer_id'::text AS native_column WHERE d.entity_type='HALL'
      UNION ALL SELECT '默认销货仓来源编号','WAREHOUSE','default_sales_warehouse_id' WHERE d.entity_type='HALL'
      UNION ALL SELECT '所属厅来源编号','HALL','hall_id' WHERE d.entity_type='STAFF'
    ) v
    WHERE d.batch_id=NEW.id AND (jsonb_typeof(s.normalized_fields->v.field) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field='' AND d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column IS NOT NULL)
      OR (s.normalized_fields->>v.field<>'' AND (d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column IS NULL
        OR (v.entity='WAREHOUSE' AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record r WHERE r.import_batch_id=NEW.id
            AND r.source_entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.target_type='WAREHOUSE' AND r.status='IMPORTED'
            AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field AND r.target_id::text=d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column))
        OR (v.entity<>'WAREHOUSE' AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference r WHERE r.batch_id=NEW.id
            AND r.entity_type=v.entity AND r.source_key=s.normalized_fields->>v.field
            AND COALESCE(r.native_hall_id,r.native_customer_id,r.native_staff_id)::text=d.native_snapshot->>v.native_column)))))
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'historical native directory has incomplete original relation coverage' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.guard_import_accounting_claim()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; r naijue_erp.import_record%ROWTYPE; native_row jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
  SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=NEW.import_batch_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF b.mapping_version<>'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' OR b.status NOT IN ('STAGED','VALIDATING')
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE status='IMPORTED') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'native accounting requires the original open unpublished V2 scope' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF b.history_payload_hash IS NULL AND (NEW.target_type<>'WAREHOUSE' OR NEW.checkpoint_sequence<>1 OR b.checkpoint->>'sequence'<>'0') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unbound CORE claims only22 fresh warehouses at original next sequence1' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Induction starts ONLY at the real original zero checkpoint. Never adopt/backfill old nonzero counters.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim WHERE import_batch_id=b.id)
    AND (b.checkpoint->>'sequence'<>'0' OR b.checkpoint->>'cursor'<>'0'
      OR b.checkpoint->'counts' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"WAREHOUSE":0,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0}'::jsonb) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'nonzero checkpoint without accounting provenance requires separately authorized recovery' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.checkpoint_sequence::bigint<>(b.checkpoint->>'sequence')::bigint+1
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim c WHERE c.import_batch_id=b.id
      AND c.checkpoint_sequence=NEW.checkpoint_sequence AND c.operation_id<>NEW.operation_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'one next original receipt must own this checkpoint sequence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  -- Primary native identities are locked before immutable source/evidence rows.
  IF NEW.target_type='WAREHOUSE' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(w) INTO STRICT native_row FROM naijue_erp.warehouse w WHERE id=NEW.target_id FOR SHARE;
  ELSIF NEW.target_type='SKU' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(k) INTO STRICT native_row FROM naijue_erp.sku k WHERE id=NEW.target_id FOR SHARE;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE id=NEW.import_record_id AND import_batch_id=b.id FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM naijue_erp.import_source_key_lock(b.source_name,r.source_entity_type,r.source_key);
  IF r.status<>'IMPORTED' OR r.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.target_type OR r.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.target_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'claim must consume its exact immutable imported target record' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.target_type='WAREHOUSE' AND (r.source_entity_type<>'WAREHOUSE' OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence e JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s
      ON s.batch_id=e.batch_id AND s.id=e.source_row_id
    WHERE e.batch_id=b.id AND e.entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND e.source_key=r.source_key AND e.native_id=r.target_id
      AND e.validator_version='NATIVE_PARTY_IMPORT_V1' AND e.native_snapshot=native_row
      AND e.warehouse_record->>'id'=r.id::text AND e.warehouse_record->>'decisionReason'=r.decision_reason
      AND (e.warehouse_record->>'reviewedAt')::timestamptz=r.reviewed_at
      AND s.entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND s.source_key=r.source_key AND s.row_sha256=r.source_record_hash AND s.file_ref=r.source_file_ref
      AND s.normalized_fields->>'切换范围'='本次完整核准')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'warehouse claim lacks exact source and native creator evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.target_type='SKU' AND (r.source_entity_type<>'SKU' OR NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row s JOIN naijue_erp.import_sku_alias a
      ON a.batch_id=s.batch_id AND a.source_row_id=s.id AND a.old_source_sku_id=s.source_key
    WHERE s.batch_id=b.id AND s.entity_type='SKU' AND s.source_key=r.source_key
      AND s.row_sha256=r.source_record_hash AND s.file_ref=r.source_file_ref
      AND a.canonical_source_key=r.source_key AND a.canonical_sku_id=r.target_id
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'validator_version'='NATIVE_SKU_IMPORT_V1'
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'canonical_source_key'=r.source_key
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'native_sku_id'=r.target_id::text
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->'native_sku'=native_row
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->'mapping'->>'isRepresentative'='true')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SKU claim requires one canonical creator record, not one record per alias' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF NEW.target_type='IMPORT_BATCH' AND (r.target_id<>b.id OR r.source_entity_type<>'INVENTORY_SCOPE_APPROVAL'
    OR r.source_key<>'FINAL_COMPLETE_SCOPE' OR r.source_record_hash<>b.source_hash OR r.source_file_ref<>b.source_manifest_ref
    OR r.decision_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMPLETE_SCOPE;ABSENT_IS_ZERO;ALL_FILES_VERIFIED;FINAL_DELTA_VERIFIED;NO_UNRESOLVED_EXCEPTIONS'
    OR b.checkpoint->'counts'->>'IMPORT_BATCH'<>'0') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'only the one original exact final complete-scope approval can be claimed' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.validate_import_accounting_final_record_commit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.target_type<>'IMPORT_BATCH' OR (SELECT mapping_version FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=NEW.import_batch_id)<>'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim c JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt r ON r.id=c.operation_id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_batch b ON b.id=c.import_batch_id
    WHERE c.import_batch_id=NEW.import_batch_id AND c.import_record_id=NEW.id AND c.target_type='IMPORT_BATCH'
      AND c.target_id=NEW.import_batch_id AND r.target_type='IMPORT' AND r.target_id=b.id AND r.action='IMPORT_PUBLISH'
      AND r.completed_at=NEW.reviewed_at AND b.status='IMPORTED') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'a new V2 FINAL record must commit atomically with its own original publication claim' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_closure_row_hash(relation_name text, row_key text, projection jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF relation_name IS NULL OR row_key IS NULL OR octet_length(convert_to(relation_name,'UTF8')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536
   OR octet_length(convert_to(row_key,'UTF8')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 OR projection IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'history closure exact row identity required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN encode(sha256(naijue_erp.history_closure_encode(jsonb_build_array('HISTORY_CLOSURE_ROW_V1',relation_name,row_key,projection))),'hex');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_closure_seed(scope text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF scope IS NULL OR octet_length(convert_to(scope,'UTF8')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 65536 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'history closure stream scope required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN sha256(naijue_erp.history_closure_encode(jsonb_build_array('HISTORY_CLOSURE_STREAM_V1',scope)));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_closure_fold(state bytea, row_hash text)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF state IS NULL OR octet_length(state)<>32 OR row_hash IS NULL OR row_hash!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'history closure exact SHA state required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN sha256(decode('01','hex')||state||decode(row_hash,'hex'));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_closure_rows(selected_batch uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(relation_name text, row_key text, projection jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH RECURSIVE src AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 party AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 refs AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 cat AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_native_catalogue_binding WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 pay AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_native_payment_binding WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 sh AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 th AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 aliases AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_sku_alias WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 contributors AS(SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_stock_contributor WHERE batch_id=selected_batch),
 skus AS(SELECT n.* FROM naijue_erp.sku n WHERE n.id IN(SELECT canonical_sku_id FROM aliases
   UNION SELECT sku_id FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line WHERE batch_id=selected_batch
   UNION SELECT sku_id FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line WHERE batch_id=selected_batch)),
 products AS(SELECT n.* FROM naijue_erp.product n WHERE n.id::text IN(SELECT field_provenance->>'native_product_id' FROM src WHERE entity_type='PRODUCT'
   UNION SELECT product_id::text FROM skus)),
 categories(id) AS(SELECT category_id FROM products UNION SELECT category_id FROM cat WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL
   UNION SELECT n.parent_id FROM naijue_erp.product_category n JOIN categories c ON c.id=n.id WHERE n.parent_id IS NOT NULL),
 warehouses AS(SELECT n.* FROM naijue_erp.warehouse n WHERE n.id IN(SELECT native_warehouse_id FROM party

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.maintenance_action_allowed(kind text, action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE kind
    WHEN 'PRODUCT' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE','DELETE')
    WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DELETE','REORDER','UNDO_REORDER')
    WHEN 'COLOR' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE','DELETE')
    WHEN 'FIT' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE','DELETE')
    WHEN 'HALL' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE')
    WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE')
    WHEN 'STAFF' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','LEAVE','REINSTATE')
    WHEN 'ACCOUNT' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE','RESET_PASSWORD')
    WHEN 'PAYMENT_METHOD' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE')
    WHEN 'PAYMENT_ACCOUNT' THEN action IN ('CREATE','EDIT','DISABLE','RESTORE')
    ELSE false END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.validate_exact_historical_customer_intent(intent naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence, batch naijue_erp.import_batch)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF intent.entity_type<>'CUSTOMER' OR NOT naijue_erp.exact_historical_customer_source_matches(intent.source_snapshot,intent.native_snapshot)
    OR intent.source_snapshot->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM batch.id::text
    OR intent.source_snapshot->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM intent.source_row_id::text
    OR intent.source_snapshot->>'source_key' IS DISTINCT FROM intent.source_key
    OR intent.native_snapshot->>'id' IS DISTINCT FROM intent.native_id::text
    OR intent.validator_version<>'NATIVE_PARTY_IMPORT_V1' OR intent.warehouse_record IS NOT NULL
    OR (intent.selection->>'entity'='CUSTOMER' AND intent.selection->>'source'='HISTORICAL_CUSTOMER_SUPPLEMENT_V1'
      AND intent.selection->>'path'='dictionaries/historical-customers.json'
      AND intent.selection->>'sourceFileSha256'='79305bfcb0545e5bc26601f839508be2b64a6637cd6fb1ef1819c6989fc38e65'
      AND intent.selection->>'selectionSha256'=batch.source_hash
      AND intent.selection->>'approvalSha256'='e471ccdef09f385688d8f5709e072a033d471f0c6fdba8b7bb1b49ad55a9408a'
      AND intent.selection->>'baseManifestSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    OR intent."authorization" IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('sourceRowId',intent.source_row_id::text,'sourceKey',intent.source_key,
      'nativeId',intent.native_id::text,'rowFingerprint',intent.row_fingerprint,'selectionSha256',intent.selection->>'selectionSha256',
      'approvalSha256',intent.selection->>'approvalSha256') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only independently pinned original historical customer identities are admitted' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.is_exact_historical_customer_only(target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE matched bigint;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record s JOIN naijue_erp.import_batch b ON b.id=s.import_batch_id WHERE s.target_type='CUSTOMER' AND s.target_id=target AND s.status='IMPORTED' AND b.mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1' AND s.decision_reason LIKE '{%"STANDARD_IMPORT_POINTER_V1"%') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF target IS NULL OR target NOT IN ('2e5bd72a-c1cb-4090-90be-091deb49bb2e'::uuid,'f8a29ce8-e296-4b95-9612-ca7bb62507bd'::uuid) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO matched FROM naijue_erp.customer c
    JOIN naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence e ON e.entity_type='CUSTOMER' AND e.native_id=c.id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=e.source_row_id AND s.batch_id=e.batch_id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_header_native_reference h ON h.batch_id=e.batch_id AND h.source_row_id=s.id
      AND h.entity_type='CUSTOMER' AND h.native_customer_id=c.id AND h.source_key=e.source_key
    WHERE c.id=target AND e.selection->>'source'='HISTORICAL_CUSTOMER_SUPPLEMENT_V1'
      AND e.selection->>'approvalSha256'='e471ccdef09f385688d8f5709e072a033d471f0c6fdba8b7bb1b49ad55a9408a'
      AND naijue_erp.exact_historical_customer_source_matches(to_jsonb(s),to_jsonb(c))
      AND e.native_snapshot=to_jsonb(c) AND h.native_snapshot=to_jsonb(c) AND h.native_version=c.version
      AND to_jsonb(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::naijue_erp.import_source_row,e.source_snapshot))=to_jsonb(s);
  IF matched<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pinned historical customer source closure is absent or inconsistent' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_native_bootstrap_accounts(selected_batch uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE core_mode boolean; core_a jsonb; b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; e record; proof jsonb; item jsonb; snapshot jsonb;
  common_binding jsonb; common_authority jsonb; binding jsonb; authority jsonb; field record;
  actual jsonb; fresh boolean; r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE;
  accounts uuid[]:=ARRAY[]::uuid[]; staff_ids uuid[]:=ARRAY[]::uuid[]; source_accounts text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];
  direct_count integer:=0; plan_count integer:=0; seen integer:=0; xid_value bigint:=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
BEGIN
  PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
  SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=selected_batch FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT birth_audit.after_values INTO core_a FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt birth_receipt JOIN naijue_erp.audit_change birth_audit ON birth_audit.operation_id=birth_receipt.id
    WHERE birth_receipt.target_type='IMPORT' AND birth_receipt.target_id=b.id AND birth_receipt.action='IMPORT_CORE_STAGE';
  core_mode:=core_a IS NOT NULL;
  IF b.status<>'STAGED' OR b.mapping_version<>'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1'
    OR b.checkpoint->'sequence'<>(CASE WHEN core_mode THEN '1'::jsonb ELSE '0'::jsonb END) OR b.checkpoint->'cursor'<>(CASE WHEN core_mode THEN '22'::jsonb ELSE '0'::jsonb END)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id<>selected_batch)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=selected_batch AND xmin::text::bigint=xid_value) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap must belong to the first fresh original STAGE transaction' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  FOR e IN SELECT i.*,s.field_provenance,s.row_sha256,to_jsonb(s) AS actual_source
    FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence i
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=i.batch_id AND s.id=i.source_row_id
    WHERE i.batch_id=selected_batch AND (s.field_provenance->'fields') ? 'bootstrap_accounts'
    ORDER BY i.native_id FOR SHARE OF i,s LOOP
    proof:=e.field_provenance->'fields'->'bootstrap_accounts'->'raw';
    IF e.entity_type<>'STAFF' OR e.creation_xid IS DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()
      OR to_jsonb(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::naijue_erp.import_source_row,e.source_snapshot)) IS DISTINCT FROM e.actual_source
      OR (jsonb_typeof(proof)='object' AND proof ?& ARRAY['version','profile','binding','authority','expected_counts','staff','accounts']
        AND proof-ARRAY['version','profile','binding','authority','expected_counts','staff','accounts']='{}'::jsonb
        AND proof->>'version'='NATIVE_BOOTSTRAP_ACCOUNTS_PROOF_V1' AND proof->>'profile'='EXACT26'
        AND proof->'expected_counts'='{"accounts":49,"direct_original_employee_links":45,"approved_current_person_links":4}'::jsonb
        AND proof->'staff'=jsonb_build_object('source_row_id',e.source_row_id,'source_key',e.source_key,
          'source_row_sha256',e.row_sha256,'native_staff_id',e.native_id)
        AND jsonb_typeof(proof->'accounts')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(proof->'accounts')=1) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap requires complete immutable original STAFF account proof' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    binding:=proof->'binding'; authority:=proof->'authority';
    IF (jsonb_typeof(binding)='object'
      AND binding ?& ARRAY['batch_id','fixed_source_namespace','selection_sha256','authorized_payload_sha256','stage_command_sha256','operation_id','actor_account_id']
      AND binding-ARRAY['batch_id','fixed_source_namespace','selection_sha256','authorized_payload_sha256','stage_command_sha256','operation_id','actor_account_id']='{}'::jsonb
      AND binding->>'batch_id'=selected_batch::text AND binding->>'fixed_source_namespace'=b.source_name
      AND binding->>'selection_sha256'=b.source_hash AND binding->>'authorized_payload_sha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND binding->>'stage_command_sha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(binding->'operation_id')='string' AND jsonb_typeof(binding->'actor_account_id')='string'
      AND jsonb_typeof(authority)='object'
      AND authority ?& ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256',
        'source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256']
      AND authority-ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256',
        'source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256']='{}'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(authority->'old_source_batch_id')='string' AND length(btrim(authority->>'old_source_batch_id'))>0) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap complete outside-authority binding required' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    FOR field IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each(authority-'old_source_batch_id') LOOP
      IF jsonb_typeof(field.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR field.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap outside-source digest is missing or malformed' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;
    IF core_mode AND (binding->>'authorized_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM core_a->>'coreSourceDigest'
      OR authority IS DISTINCT FROM (core_a->'authority')-ARRAY['target','actorAccountId','batchId','namespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','bootstrapAt','commandHash','operationId']
      OR binding->>'stage_command_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM core_a->'authority'->>'commandHash'
      OR binding->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM core_a->'authority'->>'operationId'
      OR binding->>'actor_account_id' IS DISTINCT FROM core_a->'authority'->>'actorAccountId') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE proof must bind original exact CORE digest/authority/command operation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF common_binding IS NULL THEN common_binding:=binding; common_authority:=authority;
    ELSIF binding IS DISTINCT FROM common_binding OR authority IS DISTINCT FROM common_authority THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'All bootstrap accounts must share one independently reviewed original execution' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    item:=proof->'accounts'->0; snapshot:=item->'native_snapshot';
    IF (jsonb_typeof(item)='object'
      AND item ?& ARRAY['source_account_id','source_account_version','source_employee_native_id','source_employee_code','identity_link_kind','current_person_key','source_plan_row','native_snapshot']
      AND item-ARRAY['source_account_id','source_account_version','source_employee_native_id','source_employee_code','identity_link_kind','current_person_key','source_plan_row','native_snapshot']='{}'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(item->'source_account_id')='string' AND length(btrim(item->>'source_account_id'))>0
      AND item->>'source_account_version' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(snapshot)='object' AND snapshot ?& ARRAY['id','staff_id','login_enabled','auth_version','version','created_at','updated_at']
      AND snapshot-ARRAY['id','staff_id','login_enabled','auth_version','version','created_at','updated_at']='{}'::jsonb
      AND snapshot->>'staff_id'=e.native_id::text AND snapshot->'auth_version'='1'::jsonb AND snapshot->'version'='1'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(snapshot->'login_enabled')='boolean') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap proof must contain exactly the safe seven-field account snapshot' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF item->>'identity_link_kind'='DIRECT_ORIGINAL_EMPLOYEE_V1' THEN
      IF (jsonb_typeof(item->'source_employee_native_id')='string' AND length(btrim(item->>'source_employee_native_id'))>0
        AND jsonb_typeof(item->'source_employee_code')='string' AND length(btrim(item->>'source_employee_code'))>0
        AND item->'current_person_key'='null'::jsonb AND item->'source_plan_row'='null'::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct original account relationship is incomplete' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      direct_count:=direct_count+1;
    ELSIF item->>'identity_link_kind'='APPROVED_CURRENT_PERSON_PLAN_V1' THEN
      IF (item->'source_employee_native_id'='null'::jsonb AND item->'source_employee_code'='null'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof(item->'current_person_key')='string' AND length(btrim(item->>'current_person_key'))>0
        AND item->>'source_plan_row' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reviewed current-person relationship must preserve missing original employee facts' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      plan_count:=plan_count+1;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported bootstrap identity relationship' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'staff_id',u.staff_id,'login_enabled',u.login_enabled,'auth_version',u.auth_version,
      'version',u.version,'created_at',u.created_at,'updated_at',u.updated_at),u.xmin::text::bigint=xid_value INTO STRICT actual,fresh
      FROM naijue_erp.user_account u WHERE u.id=(snapshot->>'id')::uuid FOR SHARE;
    IF NOT fresh OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_complete_row_matches(snapshot,actual)
      OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(snapshot->'created_at',to_jsonb(b.created_at))
      OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(snapshot->'updated_at',to_jsonb(b.created_at))
      OR (snapshot->>'id')::uuid=ANY(accounts) OR e.native_id=ANY(staff_ids) OR item->>'source_account_id'=ANY(source_accounts)
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.staff st WHERE st.id=e.native_id AND st.xmin::text::bigint=xid_value AND to_jsonb(st)=e.native_snapshot) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap cannot adopt, duplicate, or alter actual source-created staff/accounts' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    accounts:=array_append(accounts,(snapshot->>'id')::uuid); staff_ids:=array_append(staff_ids,e.native_id);
    source_accounts:=array_append(source_accounts,item->>'source_account_id'); seen:=seen+1;
  END LOOP;
  IF seen<>49 OR direct_count<>45 OR plan_count<>4 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.user_account)<>49
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account WHERE NOT id=ANY(accounts))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.auth_session WHERE account_id=ANY(accounts))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_ledger WHERE xmin::text::bigint=xid_value) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'First bootstrap requires complete49 account closure and no session/stock effect' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=(common_binding->>'operation_id')::uuid;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=r.id;
  IF r.actor_account_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM common_binding->>'actor_account_id'
    OR r.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM common_binding->>'stage_command_sha256'
    OR r.action<>(CASE WHEN core_mode THEN 'IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' ELSE 'IMPORT_STAGE' END) OR r.target_type<>'IMPORT' OR r.target_id<>selected_batch OR r.status<>'COMMITTED'
    OR r.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM b.created_at OR r.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM b.created_at
    OR r.result_data IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('operationId',r.id,'batchId',selected_batch,'sequence',CASE WHEN core_mode THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,'cursor',CASE WHEN core_mode THEN 22 ELSE 0 END,'status','STAGED','ledgerEntryIds','[]'::jsonb)||(CASE WHEN core_mode THEN jsonb_build_object('phase','CORE_INITIALIZED_V1','coreSourceDigest',core_a->'coreSourceDigest','coreCounts',core_a->'coreCounts') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)
    OR a.object_type<>'IMPORT' OR a.object_id<>selected_batch OR a.action<>(CASE WHEN core_mode THEN 'IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' ELSE 'IMPORT_STAGE' END) OR a.actor_account_id<>r.actor_account_id
    OR (CASE WHEN core_mode THEN a.old_version IS DISTINCT FROM 1 OR a.new_version<>2 OR a.before_values IS DISTINCT FROM '{"sequence":0,"cursor":0,"counts":{"WAREHOUSE":0,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0},"expected":{}}'::jsonb ELSE a.old_version IS NOT NULL OR a.new_version<>1 OR a.before_values IS NOT NULL END)
    OR (CASE WHEN core_mode THEN a.after_values->'checkpoint' ELSE a.after_values END) IS DISTINCT FROM b.checkpoint OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM b.created_at
    OR (b.checkpoint ?& ARRAY['sequence','cursor','counts','expected'] AND b.checkpoint-ARRAY['sequence','cursor','counts','expected']='{}'::jsonb
      AND b.checkpoint->'counts'=CASE WHEN core_mode THEN '{"WAREHOUSE":22,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0}'::jsonb ELSE '{"WAREHOUSE":0,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0}'::jsonb END) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE xmin::text::bigint=xid_value)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=r.id AND xmin::text::bigint=xid_value)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE xmin::text::bigint=xid_value)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=r.id AND xmin::text::bigint=xid_value)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u JOIN naijue_erp.staff st ON st.id=u.staff_id
      LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.hall h ON h.id=st.hall_id
      WHERE u.id=r.actor_account_id AND u.id=ANY(accounts) AND u.login_enabled AND st.employment_status='在职'
        AND st.role='ADMIN' AND (st.hall_id IS NULL OR h.enabled)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Bootstrap must commit with its one exact original STAGE audit/receipt and actual reviewed ADMIN actor' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_native_product_season_source(source naijue_erp.import_source_row)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE p naijue_erp.product%ROWTYPE; evidence jsonb; selection jsonb; ids uuid[]; ref jsonb; actual_season jsonb; position integer:=0;
BEGIN
  IF source.entity_type<>'PRODUCT' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Season source closure requires an original PRODUCT row' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  evidence:=source.field_provenance->'fields'->'native_product_import'; selection:=evidence->'season_selection';
  SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM naijue_erp.product WHERE id=(source.field_provenance->>'native_product_id')::uuid FOR SHARE;
  IF (evidence->>'validator_version'='NATIVE_PRODUCT_IMPORT_V2_EXACT26' AND evidence->>'schema_profile'='EXACT26'
      AND evidence->'migration_defaults'=jsonb_build_object('version','NATIVE_PRODUCT_APPROVED_MIGRATION_DEFAULTS_26_V1',
        'deleted_at',NULL,'default_barcode_scheme_id',NULL)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact26 product evidence version and approved technical NULL defaults required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF p.version<>1 OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR p.default_barcode_scheme_id IS NOT NULL
    OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_complete_row_matches(evidence->'native_product',to_jsonb(p))
    OR (jsonb_typeof(selection)='object' AND selection ?& ARRAY['version','mapping_sha256','source_key','source_season','state','season_ids','references']
      AND selection-ARRAY['version','mapping_sha256','source_key','source_season','state','season_ids','references']='{}'::jsonb
      AND selection->>'version'='NATIVE_PRODUCT_SEASON_SELECTION_V1'
      AND selection->>'mapping_sha256'='c05e8f46bd20d050877ae431103b52d199c953919b7e8186f822f11081f9f779'
      AND selection->>'source_key'=source.source_key AND source.raw_fields ? '季节'
      AND selection->'source_season'=source.raw_fields->'季节'
      AND source.normalized_fields->'季节'=source.raw_fields->'季节'
      AND selection->'season_ids'=coalesce(to_jsonb(p.season_ids),'null'::jsonb)
      AND jsonb_typeof(selection->'references')='array') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Complete native product season source and reviewed mapping proof required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ids:=p.season_ids;
  IF selection->>'state'='UNKNOWN' THEN
    IF (ids IS NULL AND selection->'references'='[]'::jsonb AND p.season_id IS NULL AND NOT evidence ? 'legacy_scalar_creation'
      AND (selection->'source_season'='null'::jsonb OR
        (jsonb_typeof(selection->'source_season')='string' AND btrim(selection->>'source_season')=''))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unknown original season must retain actual blank and NULL selection' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  ELSIF selection->>'state'='KNOWN' THEN
    IF ids IS NULL OR cardinality(ids)<1 OR NOT naijue_erp.valid_product_season_ids(ids)
      OR jsonb_array_length(selection->'references')<>cardinality(ids)
      OR (cardinality(ids)>1 AND p.season_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (cardinality(ids)=1 AND p.season_id IS DISTINCT FROM ids[1]) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Known season requires canonical exact member references and preserved scalar meaning' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF cardinality(ids)>1 THEN
      IF (evidence->'legacy_scalar_creation'=jsonb_build_object(
        'state','LEGACY_SINGLE_SLOT_NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_CONFIRMED_MULTI_SELECTION','value',NULL,
        'appliesOnlyTo','FRESH_NATIVE_PRODUCT_IN_NEW_DATABASE','originalSeason',selection->'source_season')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Confirmed multiple seasons require explicit fresh-product legacy-slot nonapplicability' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    ELSIF evidence ? 'legacy_scalar_creation' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Single season cannot claim multiple-selection legacy-slot exemption' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    FOR ref IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(selection->'references') LOOP
      position:=position+1;
      SELECT to_jsonb(n) INTO STRICT actual_season FROM naijue_erp.season n WHERE id=ids[position] FOR SHARE;
      IF (jsonb_typeof(ref)='object' AND ref ?& ARRAY['sourceKey','nativeId','nativeSnapshot']
        AND ref-ARRAY['sourceKey','nativeId','nativeSnapshot']='{}'::jsonb AND ref->>'nativeId'=ids[position]::text
        AND ref->'nativeSnapshot'=actual_season
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_native_catalogue_binding c
          WHERE c.batch_id=source.batch_id AND c.entity_type='SEASON' AND c.source_key=ref->>'sourceKey'
            AND c.season_id=ids[position] AND c.native_snapshot=actual_season)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Each selected season must match its whole same-batch native dictionary proof' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;
  ELSE
    -- This exact reviewed map has48 unknown,2598 single,310 multiple and zero
    -- explicit-empty sources. Runtime [] is valid; inventing it during import is not.
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original reviewed season mapping contains no other selection state' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.guard_successor_publication26()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE original_source record; target uuid; matched bigint;
BEGIN

 -- STANDARD27_BRANCH_BEGIN
 IF NEW.inventory_mode='DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' AND (current_setting('role') IN ('erp_unified27_initializer_2393dbc6db9581c2','erp_unified27_importer_2393dbc6db9581c2')
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT'
      AND after_values->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1'
      AND source_name=NEW.source_name AND source_hash=NEW.source_hash)) THEN
  DECLARE a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE;
 b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; item jsonb; expected jsonb; proof jsonb;
 actual_ids jsonb; claimed_ids jsonb; pointer jsonb; phase_name text; intent_count bigint;
BEGIN
    PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
    IF NEW.mapping_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1'
      OR NEW.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
      OR NEW.history_actual_counts IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_validation_passed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_PROFILE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1'
      AND inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE' AND status='IMPORTED'
      AND source_name=NEW.source_name AND source_hash=NEW.source_hash AND cutoff_at=NEW.cutoff_at;
    SELECT aa.* INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change aa JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt rr ON rr.id=aa.operation_id
      WHERE rr.target_type='IMPORT' AND rr.target_id=b.id AND rr.action='IMPORT_INITIALIZE_CURRENT_ADMIN'
      AND rr.status='COMMITTED' AND rr.result_data->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      AND aa.object_type='IMPORT' AND aa.object_id=b.id AND aa.action=rr.action
      AND aa.actor_account_id=rr.actor_account_id AND aa.occurred_at=rr.completed_at;
    IF a.after_values->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->'payload'->>'document_batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->'payload'->'expected_documents' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.checkpoint->'expected'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_hash THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_INITIAL_PLAN_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
      -- Stage is inserted before its receipt/audit. Only immutable INITIALIZE
      -- plan authorizes this exact identity; existing deferred validator closes it.
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,NULL,TG_OP,false);
    ELSE

    PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
    SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT'
      AND after_values->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change root_a WHERE root_a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND root_a.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint) OR (object_id=NEW.id AND new_version=(NEW.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer+1));
    IF a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' THEN PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_context_v2((a.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation')::uuid); END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=a.operation_id
      AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
    phase_name:=a.after_values->>'phase';
    IF phase_name IS NULL OR phase_name NOT IN ('MASTER','DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH')
      OR a.id IS DISTINCT FROM r.id OR a.actor_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.actor_account_id
      OR a.object_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id OR r.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'IMPORT'
      OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM r.action OR r.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMMITTED'
      OR r.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'IMPORT_PUBLISH' ELSE 'IMPORT_CHUNK' END)
      OR r.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM transaction_timestamp() OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at
      OR r.result_data->>'profile' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR r.result_data->>'phase' IS DISTINCT FROM phase_name
      OR a.after_values->>'origin' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_SOURCE'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'protocol' IS DISTINCT FROM 'STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1'
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id::text
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM r.request_key
      OR r.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(
        (CASE phase_name WHEN 'DOCUMENT_PUBLISH' THEN 'PUBLISH' ELSE phase_name END)||':'||(a.after_values->'request')::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
      OR jsonb_typeof(a.after_values->'records') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR jsonb_typeof(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
      OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u JOIN naijue_erp.staff s ON s.id=u.staff_id
        LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.hall h ON h.id=s.hall_id WHERE u.id=r.actor_account_id AND u.login_enabled
        AND s.role='ADMIN' AND s.employment_status='在职' AND (s.hall_id IS NULL OR h.enabled)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_OPERATION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=r.target_id;
    IF a.after_values->'request'->>'namespace' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_name
      OR a.after_values->'request'->>'package_manifest_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR (a.after_values->'request'->>'cutoff_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM b.cutoff_at
      OR r.result_data->>'packageManifestSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_hash
      OR r.result_data->>'planSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a.after_values->'request'->>'plan_sha256'
      OR a.new_version IS DISTINCT FROM (a.after_values->'checkpoint'->>'sequence')::integer+1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_TARGET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->>'id' ORDER BY value->>'id'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO actual_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records');
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY value),'[]'::jsonb) INTO claimed_ids
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.result_data->'sourceRecordIds');
    IF actual_ids IS DISTINCT FROM claimed_ids OR jsonb_array_length(actual_ids)=0
      OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(actual_ids))<>jsonb_array_length(actual_ids) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_PREPARED_RECORD_SET_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.after_values->'records') LOOP
      SELECT decision_reason::jsonb INTO pointer FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint;
      IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_CURRENT_RECORD_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      IF pointer IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('format','STANDARD_IMPORT_POINTER_V1','code','SOURCE_BOUND','operationId',r.id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_EXACT_POINTER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      proof:=naijue_erp.standard_import_record_proof((item->>'id')::uuid);
      IF proof->'current_operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
        OR proof->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM r.id::text OR proof->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_RECORD_PROOF_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    END LOOP;

      IF phase_name NOT IN ('DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH') OR r.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
        OR a.after_values->'checkpoint' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.checkpoint
        OR a.before_values IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.checkpoint
        OR a.after_values->'request'->>'batch_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD27_DOCUMENT_PREPARED_TRANSITION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(NEW,to_jsonb(OLD),TG_OP,NOT(a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' AND NEW.status='VALIDATING'));
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END;
 END IF;
 -- STANDARD27_BRANCH_END
  IF NEW.inventory_mode='DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' THEN
    IF NEW.mapping_version<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1' OR NEW.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=NEW.id) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'standard conversion cannot enter the legacy raw/history publication pipeline' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.mapping_version<>'V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' OR NEW.status<>'IMPORTED' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
  -- Original19 conservation, typed closure, approval/audit/accounting and no-STAGED
  -- visibility guards remain enabled. This adds actual successor-field readback.
  FOR original_source IN SELECT * FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=NEW.id AND entity_type='PRODUCT' ORDER BY id FOR SHARE LOOP
    PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_native_product_season_source(original_source::naijue_erp.import_source_row);
  END LOOP;

      IF phase_name NOT IN ('DOCUMENTS','DOCUMENT_PUBLISH') OR r.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_core_initialization_v14(selected_batch uuid, selected_operation uuid, creation boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 birth jsonb; members jsonb; item jsonb; cp jsonb; full_binding jsonb; member jsonb; step jsonb; state jsonb; actual jsonb; field record;
 ma naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; mr naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; before_root jsonb; after_root jsonb; table_name text; n bigint;
 batch_heap_xmin bigint; receipt_heap_xmin bigint;
 prefix22 jsonb; group22 jsonb; stats22 jsonb; group_name22 text; segment22 text; scope22 text;
 tables22 text[]; entities22 text[]; query22 text; part22 text; projection22 text; key22 text; state22 bytea; previous22 bytea; identity22 bytea; row22 record;

 zero_cp jsonb:='{"sequence":0,"cursor":0,"counts":{"WAREHOUSE":0,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0},"expected":{}}';
 core_cp jsonb:='{"sequence":1,"cursor":22,"counts":{"WAREHOUSE":22,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0},"expected":{}}';
BEGIN
 PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=selected_batch FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=selected_operation;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=r.id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT cr FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE target_type='IMPORT' AND target_id=b.id AND action='IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' AND status='COMMITTED';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT ca FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=cr.id;
 birth:=ca.after_values; members:=birth->'coreSourceMembers';
 IF (birth ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion','phase','coreSourceDigest','coreCounts','coreSourceMembers','authority','checkpoint','fullBinding','fullFrozen']
  AND birth-ARRAY['schemaVersion','phase','coreSourceDigest','coreCounts','coreSourceMembers','authority','checkpoint','fullBinding','fullFrozen']='{}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'schemaVersion'='1'::jsonb AND birth->>'phase'='CORE_INITIALIZED_V1' AND birth->>'coreSourceDigest'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND birth->'coreCounts'='{"STAFF":49,"HALL":22,"WAREHOUSE":22,"CUSTOMER":22,"USER_ACCOUNT":49}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'checkpoint'=core_cp AND birth->'fullBinding'='null'::jsonb AND birth->'fullFrozen'='false'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(members)='object' AND members ?& ARRAY['parties','accounts'] AND members-ARRAY['parties','accounts']='{}'::jsonb

  AND jsonb_typeof(members->'accounts')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(members->'accounts')=49
  AND birth->'authority' ?& ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256','source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256','target','actorAccountId','batchId','namespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','bootstrapAt','commandHash','operationId']
  AND (birth->'authority')-ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256','source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256','target','actorAccountId','batchId','namespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','bootstrapAt','commandHash','operationId']='{}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'authority'->>'actorAccountId'=cr.actor_account_id::text AND birth->'authority'->>'batchId'=b.id::text
  AND birth->'authority'->>'namespace'=b.source_name AND birth->'authority'->>'selectionSha256'=b.source_hash
  AND birth->'authority'->>'commandHash'=cr.request_hash AND birth->'authority'->>'operationId'=cr.id::text
  AND naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(birth->'authority'->'cutoffAt',to_jsonb(b.cutoff_at))
  AND naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(birth->'authority'->'bootstrapAt',to_jsonb(b.created_at))

  AND ca.object_type='IMPORT' AND ca.object_id=b.id AND ca.action='IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' AND ca.actor_account_id=cr.actor_account_id
  AND ca.occurred_at=cr.completed_at AND cr.created_at=b.created_at AND cr.completed_at=b.created_at
  AND cr.result_data=jsonb_build_object('operationId',cr.id,'batchId',b.id,'sequence',1,'cursor',22,'status','STAGED','ledgerEntryIds','[]'::jsonb,
   'phase','CORE_INITIALIZED_V1','coreSourceDigest',birth->'coreSourceDigest','coreCounts',birth->'coreCounts')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact immutable CORE birth/audit/receipt required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

   OR member->>'version'<>actual->>'version' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current typed CORE projection changed outside frozen maintenance chain' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $function$
