     state22:=sha256(decode('01','hex')||state22||decode(naijue_erp.history_closure_row_hash(row22.relation_name,row22.row_key,row22.projection),'hex'));
     previous22:=identity22;n:=n+1;
    END LOOP;
    stats22:=group22->segment22;
    IF n<>(stats22->>'rows')::bigint OR encode(sha256(naijue_erp.history_closure_encode(jsonb_build_array('HISTORY_CLOSURE_STREAM_FINAL_V1',scope22,n,encode(state22,'hex')))),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM stats22->>'sha256' THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual complete prefix members differ from independently authorized expected source' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
  END LOOP;
  FOREACH table_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['history_sales_line','history_sales_settlement','sales_header','sales_line','sales_settlement','transfer_header','transfer_line',
   'sku_barcode','product_image','inventory_ledger','inventory_balance','import_history_closure_manifest','import_history_document_manifest','payment_method','payment_account','payment_account_hall','history_revision'] LOOP
   EXECUTE format('SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.%I',table_name) INTO n;
   IF n<>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Prebinding prefix must not contain posted or out-of-scope effects in %',table_name USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header h LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id<>b.id OR s.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR s.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'SALES_HEADER')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=h.source_row_id
    WHERE h.batch_id<>b.id OR s.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR s.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'TRANSFER_HEADER')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=l.source_row_id
    LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_transfer_header h ON h.id=l.header_id AND h.batch_id=l.batch_id
    WHERE l.batch_id<>b.id OR s.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR s.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'TRANSFER_LINE' OR h.id IS NULL)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_sku_alias x LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=x.source_row_id
    LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.sku k ON k.id=x.canonical_sku_id WHERE x.batch_id<>b.id OR s.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id
    OR s.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'SKU' OR s.source_key IS DISTINCT FROM x.old_source_sku_id OR k.id IS NULL
    OR s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'native_sku_id' IS DISTINCT FROM k.id::text
    OR s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'canonical_source_key' IS DISTINCT FROM x.canonical_source_key)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_stock_contributor x LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=x.source_row_id
    LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.sku k ON k.id=x.canonical_sku_id LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.warehouse w ON w.id=x.warehouse_id
    WHERE x.batch_id<>b.id OR s.batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR s.entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'INVENTORY_BASELINE'
    OR k.id IS NULL OR w.id IS NULL OR x.baseline_ledger_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.sku k WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record rec
     JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.batch_id=rec.import_batch_id AND s.entity_type='SKU' AND s.source_key=rec.source_key
     WHERE rec.import_batch_id=b.id AND rec.target_type='SKU' AND rec.target_id=k.id AND rec.source_entity_type='SKU' AND rec.status='IMPORTED'
      AND rec.source_record_hash=s.row_sha256 AND rec.source_file_ref=s.file_ref
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'native_sku_id'=k.id::text
      AND s.field_provenance->'native_sku_import'->>'canonical_source_key'=rec.source_key))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.product p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row s WHERE s.batch_id=b.id AND s.entity_type='PRODUCT' AND s.field_provenance->>'native_product_id'=p.id::text))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE import_batch_id=b.id AND target_type NOT IN('WAREHOUSE','SKU'))
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim WHERE import_batch_id=b.id AND target_type<>'WAREHOUSE') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only complete original source-bound native prefix and zero posted effect may precede binding' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

  END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Exact current master versions: reconstruct each sparse authorized audit link from immutable source birth.
 IF (full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding' ?& ARRAY['version','members']
  AND (full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding')-ARRAY['version','members']='{}'::jsonb
  AND full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding'->>'version'='CORE_MAINTENANCE_BINDING_V1'
  AND jsonb_typeof(full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding'->'members')='array'
  AND jsonb_array_length(full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding'->'members')=115
  AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'sourceRowId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding'->'members') x)=115) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact115 current core maintenance projections required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR member IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(full_binding->'coreMaintenanceBinding'->'members') LOOP
  IF (member ?& ARRAY['sourceRowId','entity','sourceKey','nativeId','version','nativeSnapshot','operations']
   AND member-ARRAY['sourceRowId','entity','sourceKey','nativeId','version','nativeSnapshot','operations']='{}'::jsonb
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') x WHERE x=member-ARRAY['version','nativeSnapshot','operations'])
   AND jsonb_typeof(member->'operations')='array') IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Maintenance member not original CORE identity' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence WHERE batch_id=b.id AND source_row_id=(member->>'sourceRowId')::uuid;
  state:=e.native_snapshot;
  FOR step IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(member->'operations') LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT ma FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=(step->>'operationId')::uuid;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT mr FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=ma.operation_id;
   IF (step ?& ARRAY['operationId','fromVersion','toVersion'] AND step-ARRAY['operationId','fromVersion','toVersion']='{}'::jsonb
    AND ma.object_type=e.entity_type AND ma.object_id=e.native_id AND mr.target_type=ma.object_type AND mr.target_id=ma.object_id
    AND mr.action=ma.action AND mr.actor_account_id=ma.actor_account_id AND mr.status='COMMITTED' AND mr.completed_at=ma.occurred_at
    AND ma.old_version=(state->>'version')::integer AND ma.new_version=ma.old_version+1
    AND step->>'fromVersion'=ma.old_version::text AND step->>'toVersion'=ma.new_version::text
    AND mr.result_data->>'operationId'=ma.operation_id::text
    AND coalesce(mr.result_data->>'targetId',mr.result_data->>'customerId')=ma.object_id::text
    AND mr.result_data->>'version'=ma.new_version::text
    AND ma.occurred_at>=cr.completed_at AND ma.occurred_at<=r.completed_at) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact authorized master maintenance version chain required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   before_root:=ma.before_values-ARRAY['accounts','account_credentials']; after_root:=ma.after_values-ARRAY['accounts','account_credentials'];
   FOR field IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_each(before_root) LOOP
    IF NOT state ? field.key OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(field.value,state->field.key) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Maintenance before chain differs from original source birth/current link' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(after_root) x(k) WHERE NOT state ? k) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invented master fields forbidden' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   IF NOT (before_root ? 'version') OR NOT (after_root ? 'version') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Maintenance versions must be explicitly evidenced' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
   state:=state||after_root;
   IF state->>'version'<>ma.new_version::text THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Maintenance version link missing' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  table_name:=CASE e.entity_type WHEN 'HALL' THEN 'hall' WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN 'warehouse' WHEN 'STAFF' THEN 'staff' WHEN 'CUSTOMER' THEN 'customer' END;
  EXECUTE format('SELECT to_jsonb(n) FROM naijue_erp.%I n WHERE id=$1 FOR SHARE',table_name) INTO STRICT actual USING e.native_id;
  IF NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_complete_row_matches(state,actual) OR NOT naijue_erp.maintenance_complete_row_matches(member->'nativeSnapshot',actual)
   OR member->>'version'<>actual->>'version' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current typed CORE projection changed outside frozen maintenance chain' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_numeric_current_facts(kind text, target uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE h jsonb; d record; e jsonb; lines jsonb; settlements jsonb; result jsonb; document_version integer; effective_facts jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF kind='SALES' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) INTO STRICT h FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_header x WHERE x.id=target FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) INTO e FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_effective x WHERE x.header_id=target FOR UPDATE;
  ELSIF kind='TRANSFER' THEN
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) INTO STRICT h FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_header x WHERE x.id=target FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) INTO e FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_effective x WHERE x.header_id=target FOR UPDATE;
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual historical document kind required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  document_version:=coalesce((e->>'version')::integer,(h->>'version')::integer);
  SELECT md.typed_document_sha256,md.line_count,md.settlement_count,r.id AS published_operation_id INTO STRICT d
    FROM naijue_erp.import_batch b JOIN naijue_erp.import_history_closure_manifest m ON m.batch_id=b.id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_history_document_manifest md ON md.batch_id=b.id AND md.document_kind=kind
      AND (CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN md.sales_header_id ELSE md.transfer_header_id END)=target
      AND md.header_source_row_id=(h->>'source_row_id')::uuid
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_record f ON f.import_batch_id=b.id AND f.target_type='IMPORT_BATCH' AND f.target_id=b.id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim c ON c.import_batch_id=b.id AND c.import_record_id=f.id AND c.target_type=f.target_type AND c.target_id=f.target_id
    JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt r ON r.id=c.operation_id JOIN naijue_erp.audit_change a ON a.operation_id=r.id
    WHERE b.id=(h->>'batch_id')::uuid AND b.mapping_version='V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' AND b.inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE'
      AND b.status='IMPORTED' AND b.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND b.history_validation_passed IS TRUE
      AND b.history_actual_counts=b.history_expected_counts AND b.checkpoint->'counts'=b.checkpoint->'expected'
      AND b.checkpoint->'counts'->>'IMPORT_BATCH'='1' AND m.validator_version='HISTORY_TYPED_CLOSURE_V1'
      AND m.selection_sha256=b.source_hash AND m.authorized_payload_hash=b.history_payload_hash AND m.expected_counts=b.history_expected_counts
      AND m.document_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.import_history_document_manifest x WHERE x.batch_id=b.id)
      AND f.status='IMPORTED' AND f.source_entity_type='INVENTORY_SCOPE_APPROVAL' AND f.source_key='FINAL_COMPLETE_SCOPE'
      AND f.source_record_hash=b.source_hash AND f.source_file_ref=b.source_manifest_ref
      AND f.decision_reason='COMPLETE_SCOPE;ABSENT_IS_ZERO;ALL_FILES_VERIFIED;FINAL_DELTA_VERIFIED;NO_UNRESOLVED_EXCEPTIONS'
      AND c.checkpoint_sequence=(b.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer AND r.target_type='IMPORT' AND r.target_id=b.id
      AND r.action='IMPORT_PUBLISH' AND r.status='COMMITTED' AND r.result_data->>'status'='IMPORTED'
      AND r.result_data->>'batchId'=b.id::text AND r.result_data->>'sequence'=b.checkpoint->>'sequence' AND r.result_data->>'cursor'=b.checkpoint->>'cursor'
      AND a.object_type='IMPORT' AND a.object_id=b.id AND a.action=r.action AND a.actor_account_id=r.actor_account_id AND a.occurred_at=r.completed_at
      AND b.xmin::text::bigint<>mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      AND r.xmin::text::bigint<>mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
    FOR SHARE OF b,m,md,f,c,r,a;
  IF e IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_revision x WHERE x.id=(e->>'revision_id')::uuid
    AND x.document_kind=kind AND (CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN x.sales_id ELSE x.transfer_id END)=target
    AND x.to_version=document_version AND x.to_version=x.from_version+1 AND x.operation_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original effective head has no exact revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF e IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT after_facts INTO STRICT effective_facts FROM naijue_erp.history_revision WHERE id=(e->>'revision_id')::uuid; END IF;
  IF kind='SALES' THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line l JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id
      LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE l.header_id=target
      AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'SALES' OR x.sales_id<>target OR x.transfer_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement s JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement_effective v ON v.settlement_id=s.id
        LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE s.header_id=target
        AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'SALES' OR x.sales_id<>target OR x.transfer_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Foreign or future effective row' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId',l.id,'skuId',l.sku_id,'quantity',coalesce(v.quantity,l.quantity)::text,
      'dealPrice',coalesce(v.deal_price,l.deal_price)::text,'lineAmount',coalesce(v.line_amount,l.line_amount)::text,
      'allocatedDiscount',(CASE WHEN v.line_id IS NULL THEN l.allocated_discount ELSE v.allocated_discount END)::text) ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id),'[]') INTO lines
      FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line l LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id WHERE l.header_id=target;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('settlementId',s.id,'direction',s.direction,'amount',coalesce(v.amount,s.amount)::text) ORDER BY s.line_no,s.id),'[]') INTO settlements
      FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement s LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement_effective v ON v.settlement_id=s.id WHERE s.header_id=target;
  ELSE
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l JOIN naijue_erp.history_transfer_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id
      LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE l.header_id=target
      AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'TRANSFER' OR x.transfer_id<>target OR x.sales_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Foreign or future effective row' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId',l.id,'skuId',l.sku_id,'quantity',coalesce(v.quantity,l.quantity)::text) ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id),'[]') INTO lines
      FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_transfer_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id WHERE l.header_id=target;
    settlements:='[]';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(lines)<>d.line_count OR d.line_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
    OR jsonb_array_length(settlements)<>d.settlement_count OR d.settlement_count NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Complete bounded original line and settlement set required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('kind',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN 'sales' ELSE 'transfers' END,'documentId',target,'version',document_version,
    'previousRevisionId',e->>'revision_id','importBatchId',h->>'batch_id','publishedOperationId',d.published_operation_id,'documentManifestHash',d.typed_document_sha256,
    'sourceStatus',h->>'source_status','baselineEffect',CASE h->>'source_status' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'INCLUDED_APPROVED' ELSE 'EXCLUDED_NOT_EFFECTIVE' END,
    'businessDate',CASE WHEN effective_facts IS NULL THEN h->'business_date' ELSE effective_facts->'businessDate' END,'responsibleStaffId',coalesce(effective_facts->'responsibleStaffId','null'::jsonb),'warehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN h->>'warehouse_id' ELSE NULL END,
    'fromWarehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN coalesce(effective_facts->>'fromWarehouseId',h->>'from_warehouse_id') ELSE NULL END,'toWarehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN coalesce(effective_facts->>'toWarehouseId',h->>'to_warehouse_id') ELSE NULL END,
    'lines',lines,'totals',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN jsonb_build_object('grossAmount',coalesce(e->>'gross_amount',(h->>'gross_amount')::numeric(18,2)::text),
      'orderDiscount',coalesce(e->>'order_discount',(h->>'order_discount')::numeric(18,2)::text),'netDue',coalesce(e->>'net_due',(h->>'net_due')::numeric(18,2)::text)) ELSE NULL END,'settlements',settlements);
  -- jsonb numeric head values lose scale; make the money strings canonical.
  IF kind='SALES' AND e IS NOT NULL THEN result:=jsonb_set(result,'{totals}',jsonb_build_object('grossAmount',(e->>'gross_amount')::numeric(18,2)::text,
    'orderDiscount',(e->>'order_discount')::numeric(18,2)::text,'netDue',(e->>'net_due')::numeric(18,2)::text)); END IF;
  IF kind='TRANSFER' THEN
    result:=result||jsonb_build_object('note',CASE WHEN effective_facts ? 'note' THEN effective_facts->'note' ELSE h->'note' END);
    IF effective_facts ? 'draftLineSetVersion' THEN
      IF h->>'source_status'<>'DRAFT' OR effective_facts->'draftLineSetVersion'<>'1'::jsonb
        OR jsonb_typeof(effective_facts->'lines') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_array_length(effective_facts->'lines') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        OR jsonb_typeof(effective_facts->'nativeGroups') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Committed draft line set has invalid provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      result:=result||jsonb_build_object('draftLineSetVersion',1,'lines',effective_facts->'lines','nativeGroups',effective_facts->'nativeGroups');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN result;
END $function$

BEGIN

    SELECT to_jsonb(x) INTO e FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_effective x WHERE x.header_id=target FOR UPDATE;
  ELSIF kind='TRANSFER' THEN

  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'Actual historical document kind required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

  SELECT md.typed_document_sha256,md.line_count,md.settlement_count,r.id AS published_operation_id INTO STRICT d
    FROM naijue_erp.import_batch b JOIN naijue_erp.import_history_closure_manifest m ON m.batch_id=b.id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_history_document_manifest md ON md.batch_id=b.id AND md.document_kind=kind
      AND (CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN md.sales_header_id ELSE md.transfer_header_id END)=target
      AND md.header_source_row_id=(h->>'source_row_id')::uuid
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_record f ON f.import_batch_id=b.id AND f.target_type='IMPORT_BATCH' AND f.target_id=b.id
    JOIN naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim c ON c.import_batch_id=b.id AND c.import_record_id=f.id AND c.target_type=f.target_type AND c.target_id=f.target_id
    JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt r ON r.id=c.operation_id JOIN naijue_erp.audit_change a ON a.operation_id=r.id
    WHERE b.id=(h->>'batch_id')::uuid AND b.mapping_version='V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' AND b.inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE'
      AND b.status='IMPORTED' AND b.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND b.history_validation_passed IS TRUE
      AND b.history_actual_counts=b.history_expected_counts AND b.checkpoint->'counts'=b.checkpoint->'expected'
      AND b.checkpoint->'counts'->>'IMPORT_BATCH'='1' AND m.validator_version='HISTORY_TYPED_CLOSURE_V1'
      AND m.selection_sha256=b.source_hash AND m.authorized_payload_hash=b.history_payload_hash AND m.expected_counts=b.history_expected_counts
      AND m.document_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.import_history_document_manifest x WHERE x.batch_id=b.id)
      AND f.status='IMPORTED' AND f.source_entity_type='INVENTORY_SCOPE_APPROVAL' AND f.source_key='FINAL_COMPLETE_SCOPE'
      AND f.source_record_hash=b.source_hash AND f.source_file_ref=b.source_manifest_ref
      AND f.decision_reason='COMPLETE_SCOPE;ABSENT_IS_ZERO;ALL_FILES_VERIFIED;FINAL_DELTA_VERIFIED;NO_UNRESOLVED_EXCEPTIONS'
      AND c.checkpoint_sequence=(b.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer AND r.target_type='IMPORT' AND r.target_id=b.id
      AND r.action='IMPORT_PUBLISH' AND r.status='COMMITTED' AND r.result_data->>'status'='IMPORTED'
      AND r.result_data->>'batchId'=b.id::text AND r.result_data->>'sequence'=b.checkpoint->>'sequence' AND r.result_data->>'cursor'=b.checkpoint->>'cursor'
      AND a.object_type='IMPORT' AND a.object_id=b.id AND a.action=r.action AND a.actor_account_id=r.actor_account_id AND a.occurred_at=r.completed_at
      AND b.xmin::text::bigint<>mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      AND r.xmin::text::bigint<>mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
    FOR SHARE OF b,m,md,f,c,r,a;
  IF e IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_revision x WHERE x.id=(e->>'revision_id')::uuid
    AND x.document_kind=kind AND (CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN x.sales_id ELSE x.transfer_id END)=target
    AND x.to_version=document_version AND x.to_version=x.from_version+1 AND x.operation_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original effective head has no exact revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  IF e IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT after_facts INTO STRICT effective_facts FROM naijue_erp.history_revision WHERE id=(e->>'revision_id')::uuid; END IF;
  IF kind='SALES' THEN
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line l JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id
      LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE l.header_id=target
      AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'SALES' OR x.sales_id<>target OR x.transfer_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement s JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement_effective v ON v.settlement_id=s.id
        LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE s.header_id=target
        AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'SALES' OR x.sales_id<>target OR x.transfer_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Foreign or future effective row' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId',l.id,'skuId',l.sku_id,'quantity',coalesce(v.quantity,l.quantity)::text,
      'dealPrice',coalesce(v.deal_price,l.deal_price)::text,'lineAmount',coalesce(v.line_amount,l.line_amount)::text,
      'allocatedDiscount',(CASE WHEN v.line_id IS NULL THEN l.allocated_discount ELSE v.allocated_discount END)::text) ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id),'[]') INTO lines
      FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line l LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id WHERE l.header_id=target;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('settlementId',s.id,'direction',s.direction,'amount',coalesce(v.amount,s.amount)::text) ORDER BY s.line_no,s.id),'[]') INTO settlements
      FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement s LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement_effective v ON v.settlement_id=s.id WHERE s.header_id=target;
  ELSE
    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l JOIN naijue_erp.history_transfer_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id
      LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_revision x ON x.id=v.revision_id WHERE l.header_id=target
      AND (x.id IS NULL OR x.document_kind<>'TRANSFER' OR x.transfer_id<>target OR x.sales_id IS NOT NULL OR x.to_version>document_version)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Foreign or future effective row' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lineId',l.id,'skuId',l.sku_id,'quantity',coalesce(v.quantity,l.quantity)::text) ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id),'[]') INTO lines
      FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.history_transfer_line_effective v ON v.line_id=l.id WHERE l.header_id=target;
    settlements:='[]';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(lines)<>d.line_count OR d.line_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
    OR jsonb_array_length(settlements)<>d.settlement_count OR d.settlement_count NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Complete bounded original line and settlement set required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('kind',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN 'sales' ELSE 'transfers' END,'documentId',target,'version',document_version,
    'previousRevisionId',e->>'revision_id','importBatchId',h->>'batch_id','publishedOperationId',d.published_operation_id,'documentManifestHash',d.typed_document_sha256,
    'sourceStatus',h->>'source_status','baselineEffect',CASE h->>'source_status' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 'INCLUDED_APPROVED' ELSE 'EXCLUDED_NOT_EFFECTIVE' END,
    'businessDate',CASE WHEN effective_facts IS NULL THEN h->'business_date' ELSE effective_facts->'businessDate' END,'responsibleStaffId',coalesce(effective_facts->'responsibleStaffId','null'::jsonb),'warehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN h->>'warehouse_id' ELSE NULL END,
    'fromWarehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN coalesce(effective_facts->>'fromWarehouseId',h->>'from_warehouse_id') ELSE NULL END,'toWarehouseId',CASE kind WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN coalesce(effective_facts->>'toWarehouseId',h->>'to_warehouse_id') ELSE NULL END,
    'lines',lines,'totals',CASE kind WHEN 'SALES' THEN jsonb_build_object('grossAmount',coalesce(e->>'gross_amount',(h->>'gross_amount')::numeric(18,2)::text),
      'orderDiscount',coalesce(e->>'order_discount',(h->>'order_discount')::numeric(18,2)::text),'netDue',coalesce(e->>'net_due',(h->>'net_due')::numeric(18,2)::text)) ELSE NULL END,'settlements',settlements);
  -- jsonb numeric head values lose scale; make the money strings canonical.
  IF kind='SALES' AND e IS NOT NULL THEN result:=jsonb_set(result,'{totals}',jsonb_build_object('grossAmount',(e->>'gross_amount')::numeric(18,2)::text,
    'orderDiscount',(e->>'order_discount')::numeric(18,2)::text,'netDue',(e->>'net_due')::numeric(18,2)::text)); END IF;
  IF kind='TRANSFER' THEN
    result:=result||jsonb_build_object('note',CASE WHEN effective_facts ? 'note' THEN effective_facts->'note' ELSE h->'note' END);
    IF effective_facts ? 'draftLineSetVersion' THEN
      IF h->>'source_status'<>'DRAFT' OR effective_facts->'draftLineSetVersion'<>'1'::jsonb
        OR jsonb_typeof(effective_facts->'lines') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
        OR jsonb_array_length(effective_facts->'lines') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        OR jsonb_typeof(effective_facts->'nativeGroups') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Committed draft line set has invalid provenance' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
      result:=result||jsonb_build_object('draftLineSetVersion',1,'lines',effective_facts->'lines','nativeGroups',effective_facts->'nativeGroups');
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN result;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.validate_history_numeric_receipt_commit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.target_type NOT IN ('HISTORY_SALES','HISTORY_TRANSFER') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_revision r WHERE r.operation_id=NEW.id AND r.id::text=NEW.result_data->>'revisionId'
    AND r.actor_account_id=NEW.actor_account_id AND r.request_key=NEW.request_key AND r.changed_at=NEW.completed_at
    AND r.to_version::text=NEW.result_data->>'version' AND r.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
    AND ((NEW.target_type='HISTORY_SALES' AND r.document_kind='SALES' AND r.sales_id=NEW.target_id AND r.transfer_id IS NULL)
      OR (NEW.target_type='HISTORY_TRANSFER' AND r.document_kind='TRANSFER' AND r.transfer_id=NEW.target_id AND r.sales_id IS NULL))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical receipt cannot commit without its original current revision' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_barcode_scheme_initialization_v19(selected_batch uuid, selected_operation uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE init jsonb; before_cp jsonb; after_cp jsonb; scheme_rows jsonb; birth_binding uuid; fresh boolean;
 approved jsonb:=$approved$[{"sourceSchemeKey":"2018","native":{"id":"c0b009e7-6f61-447a-b87e-ceea62711ec9","name":"18年货品","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":9,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"HISTORICAL"}},{"sourceSchemeKey":"2020","native":{"id":"82656465-2758-4be8-a965-412a971e9c4b","name":"2020年新方案","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。2020颜色1位、尺码2位的最后补充优先于原表旧备注。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":14,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"HISTORICAL"}},{"sourceSchemeKey":"2021","native":{"id":"bc7ff32c-1025-4c30-8950-0b33a492c538","name":"2021年条码方案","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":13,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"HISTORICAL"}},{"sourceSchemeKey":"2021fit","native":{"id":"48c4fe44-7521-44c1-a0e3-c547a1691028","name":"2021年版型条码方案","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":14,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"HISTORICAL"}},{"sourceSchemeKey":"2023","native":{"id":"9c584ada-9d42-4159-9e51-208577657021","name":"2023年条码方案","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":14,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"HISTORICAL"}},{"sourceSchemeKey":"2026","native":{"id":"0e70e45e-1a51-4d44-afe8-0002cf3fb7ef","name":"2026年条码方案","barcode_type":"Code128","rule_description":"原方案描述快照；保留每条原条码和已确认SKU绑定，不依据本说明重新生成、补位、截断或改码。声明总长仅保留方案说明，不代替每条历史原码。","code_length":15,"rule_version":"NATIVE_SOURCE_RETAINED_V1","status":"CURRENT"}}]$approved$;
 pins jsonb:=$pins${"proposalSha256":"826e63b33e8e2f52a521d5ba3e930899d61092dfb22f65b11db4f799f7efef00","approvalSha256":"f9da50c270c14321b17af06255a5f0649daf8b55a725b6a29fe483f342517533","writeContractReplySha256":"9ec37b0219f227fa39e754364ea04f1962866664283812f8d9b383ba19b2acfc"}$pins$;
 b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE;
 cr naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; ca naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; e naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence%ROWTYPE;
 birth jsonb; members jsonb; item jsonb; cp jsonb; full_binding jsonb; member jsonb; step jsonb; state jsonb; actual jsonb; field record;
 ma naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; mr naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; before_root jsonb; after_root jsonb; table_name text; n bigint;
 batch_heap_xmin bigint; receipt_heap_xmin bigint;
 zero_cp jsonb:='{"sequence":0,"cursor":0,"counts":{"WAREHOUSE":0,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0},"expected":{}}';
 core_cp jsonb:='{"sequence":1,"cursor":22,"counts":{"WAREHOUSE":22,"SKU":0,"INVENTORY_LEDGER":0,"IMPORT_BATCH":0},"expected":{}}';
BEGIN
 PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=selected_batch FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=selected_operation;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=r.id;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT cr FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE target_type='IMPORT' AND target_id=b.id AND action='IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' AND status='COMMITTED';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT ca FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=cr.id;
 birth:=ca.after_values; members:=birth->'coreSourceMembers';
 IF (birth ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion','phase','coreSourceDigest','coreCounts','coreSourceMembers','authority','checkpoint','fullBinding','fullFrozen']
  AND birth-ARRAY['schemaVersion','phase','coreSourceDigest','coreCounts','coreSourceMembers','authority','checkpoint','fullBinding','fullFrozen']='{}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'schemaVersion'='1'::jsonb AND birth->>'phase'='CORE_INITIALIZED_V1' AND birth->>'coreSourceDigest'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND birth->'coreCounts'='{"STAFF":49,"HALL":22,"WAREHOUSE":22,"CUSTOMER":22,"USER_ACCOUNT":49}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'checkpoint'=core_cp AND birth->'fullBinding'='null'::jsonb AND birth->'fullFrozen'='false'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(members)='object' AND members ?& ARRAY['parties','accounts'] AND members-ARRAY['parties','accounts']='{}'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(members->'parties')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(members->'parties')=115
  AND jsonb_typeof(members->'accounts')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(members->'accounts')=49
  AND birth->'authority' ?& ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256','source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256','target','actorAccountId','batchId','namespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','bootstrapAt','commandHash','operationId']
  AND (birth->'authority')-ARRAY['account_capture_sha256','account_decisions_sha256','identity_review_sha256','bootstrap_execution_review_sha256','source_identity_facts_sha256','approved_employee_plan_sha256','old_source_batch_id','old_source_manifest_sha256','target','actorAccountId','batchId','namespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','bootstrapAt','commandHash','operationId']='{}'::jsonb
  AND birth->'authority'->>'actorAccountId'=cr.actor_account_id::text AND birth->'authority'->>'batchId'=b.id::text
  AND birth->'authority'->>'namespace'=b.source_name AND birth->'authority'->>'selectionSha256'=b.source_hash
  AND birth->'authority'->>'commandHash'=cr.request_hash AND birth->'authority'->>'operationId'=cr.id::text
  AND naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(birth->'authority'->'cutoffAt',to_jsonb(b.cutoff_at))
  AND naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(birth->'authority'->'bootstrapAt',to_jsonb(b.created_at))
  AND ca.old_version=1 AND ca.new_version=2 AND ca.before_values=zero_cp
  AND ca.object_type='IMPORT' AND ca.object_id=b.id AND ca.action='IMPORT_CORE_STAGE' AND ca.actor_account_id=cr.actor_account_id
  AND ca.occurred_at=cr.completed_at AND cr.created_at=b.created_at AND cr.completed_at=b.created_at
  AND cr.result_data=jsonb_build_object('operationId',cr.id,'batchId',b.id,'sequence',1,'cursor',22,'status','STAGED','ledgerEntryIds','[]'::jsonb,
   'phase','CORE_INITIALIZED_V1','coreSourceDigest',birth->'coreSourceDigest','coreCounts',birth->'coreCounts')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact immutable CORE birth/audit/receipt required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'sourceRowId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') x)<>115
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'nativeId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') x)<>115
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'accounts') x)<>49
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'staff_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'accounts') x)<>49 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE members must retain distinct source/native identities' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') LOOP
  IF (jsonb_typeof(item)='object' AND item ?& ARRAY['sourceRowId','entity','sourceKey','nativeId']
    AND item-ARRAY['sourceRowId','entity','sourceKey','nativeId']='{}'::jsonb AND item->>'entity' IN('STAFF','HALL','WAREHOUSE','CUSTOMER')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact CORE party member tuple required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence WHERE batch_id=b.id AND source_row_id=(item->>'sourceRowId')::uuid
   AND entity_type=item->>'entity' AND source_key=item->>'sourceKey' AND native_id=(item->>'nativeId')::uuid;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row s WHERE s.id=e.source_row_id AND s.batch_id=e.batch_id
   AND to_jsonb(s)=to_jsonb(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::naijue_erp.import_source_row,e.source_snapshot))) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE immutable source differs from birth evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOREACH table_name IN ARRAY ARRAY['STAFF','HALL','WAREHOUSE','CUSTOMER'] LOOP
  SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') x WHERE x->>'entity'=table_name;
  IF n<>(birth->'coreCounts'->>table_name)::bigint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE exact entity member counts required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'accounts') LOOP
  IF (item ?& ARRAY['id','staff_id','login_enabled','auth_version','version','created_at','updated_at']
   AND item-ARRAY['id','staff_id','login_enabled','auth_version','version','created_at','updated_at']='{}'::jsonb
   AND item->'version'='1'::jsonb AND item->'auth_version'='1'::jsonb
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence e JOIN naijue_erp.import_source_row s ON s.id=e.source_row_id
    WHERE e.batch_id=b.id AND e.entity_type='STAFF' AND e.native_id=(item->>'staff_id')::uuid
    AND s.field_provenance->'fields'->'bootstrap_accounts'->'raw'->'accounts'->0->'native_snapshot'=item)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u WHERE u.id=(item->>'id')::uuid AND u.staff_id=(item->>'staff_id')::uuid)) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE retains original safe account birth proof and live identity only' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim WHERE operation_id=cr.id)<>22
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim c LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.import_record rec ON rec.id=c.import_record_id
   LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.native_party_import_evidence e ON e.batch_id=c.import_batch_id AND e.entity_type='WAREHOUSE' AND e.native_id=c.target_id
   WHERE c.operation_id=cr.id AND (c.import_batch_id<>b.id OR c.target_type<>'WAREHOUSE' OR c.checkpoint_sequence<>1 OR c.claimed_at<>b.created_at
    OR rec.import_batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.id OR rec.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'WAREHOUSE' OR rec.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.target_id
    OR rec.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'IMPORTED' OR rec.source_entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'WAREHOUSE'
    OR rec.source_key IS DISTINCT FROM e.source_key OR rec.source_record_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.source_snapshot->>'row_sha256'
    OR rec.source_file_ref IS DISTINCT FROM e.source_snapshot->>'file_ref'
    OR e.warehouse_record IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object('id',rec.id,'reviewedAt',e.warehouse_record->'reviewedAt','decisionReason',rec.decision_reason)
    OR rec.reviewed_at IS DISTINCT FROM (e.warehouse_record->>'reviewedAt')::timestamptz
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(members->'parties') x WHERE x->>'entity'='WAREHOUSE' AND x->>'nativeId'=c.target_id::text))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORE must retain its22 exact original warehouse claims and creator records' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;

 init:=a.after_values->'schemeInitialization'; before_cp:=a.before_values->'checkpoint'; after_cp:=a.after_values->'checkpoint';
 fresh:=(SELECT q.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt q WHERE q.id=r.id);
 IF (r.target_type='IMPORT' AND r.target_id=b.id AND r.action='IMPORT_INITIALIZE_BARCODE_SCHEMES' AND r.status='COMMITTED'
  AND r.actor_account_id=cr.actor_account_id AND length(btrim(r.request_key))>0 AND r.request_hash~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND a.object_type='IMPORT' AND a.object_id=b.id AND a.action=r.action AND a.actor_account_id=r.actor_account_id
  AND a.occurred_at=r.completed_at AND r.created_at=r.completed_at AND a.new_version=a.old_version+1
  AND a.before_values ?& ARRAY['checkpoint','schemes'] AND a.before_values-ARRAY['checkpoint','schemes']='{}'::jsonb
  AND a.before_values->'schemes'='[]'::jsonb
  AND a.after_values ?& ARRAY['checkpoint','schemeInitialization','commandHash'] AND a.after_values-ARRAY['checkpoint','schemeInitialization','commandHash']='{}'::jsonb
  AND a.after_values->>'commandHash'=r.request_hash
  AND before_cp ?& ARRAY['sequence','cursor','counts','expected'] AND before_cp-ARRAY['sequence','cursor','counts','expected']='{}'::jsonb
  AND jsonb_typeof(before_cp->'sequence')='number' AND before_cp->>'sequence'~'^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND jsonb_typeof(before_cp->'cursor')='number' AND before_cp->>'cursor'~'^[0-9]+$'
  AND (before_cp->>'sequence')::bigint+1=(after_cp->>'sequence')::bigint
  AND a.old_version=(before_cp->>'sequence')::integer+1 AND a.new_version=(after_cp->>'sequence')::integer+1
  AND after_cp=jsonb_set(before_cp,'{sequence}',to_jsonb((before_cp->>'sequence')::integer+1))
  AND init ?& ARRAY['version','coreReceiptId','coreSourceDigest','fixedSourceNamespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','target','approvalPins','schemes']
  AND init-ARRAY['version','coreReceiptId','coreSourceDigest','fixedSourceNamespace','selectionSha256','cutoffAt','target','approvalPins','schemes']='{}'::jsonb
  AND init->>'version'='BARCODE_SCHEME_INITIALIZATION_V19' AND init->>'coreReceiptId'=cr.id::text AND init->>'coreSourceDigest'=birth->>'coreSourceDigest'
  AND init->>'fixedSourceNamespace'=b.source_name AND init->>'selectionSha256'=b.source_hash
  AND naijue_erp.maintenance_evidence_matches(init->'cutoffAt',to_jsonb(b.cutoff_at)) AND init->'approvalPins'=pins
  AND init->'target'=jsonb_build_object('database',current_database(),'role',current_user,'serverAddress',inet_server_addr()::text,'serverPort',inet_server_port(),'postmasterStartedAt',pg_postmaster_start_time()::text)
  AND jsonb_typeof(init->'schemes')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(init->'schemes')=6
  AND (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x->>'sourceSchemeKey') FROM jsonb_array_elements(init->'schemes') x)=approved
  AND b.mapping_version='V2_HISTORY_NULLABLE_1' AND b.inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE'
  AND b.status IN('STAGED','VALIDATING') AND b.completed_at IS NULL AND NOT b.history_validation_passed
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE status='IMPORTED')
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE target_type='IMPORT' AND target_id=b.id AND action=r.action)=1
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim WHERE operation_id=r.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_ledger WHERE operation_id=r.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_balance WHERE last_operation_id=r.id)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account u JOIN naijue_erp.staff st ON st.id=u.staff_id LEFT JOIN naijue_erp.hall h ON h.id=st.hall_id
   WHERE u.id=r.actor_account_id AND u.login_enabled AND st.employment_status='在职' AND st.role='ADMIN' AND (st.hall_id IS NULL OR h.enabled))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact original source-bound six-scheme operation/birth/actor/checkpoint audit and receipt required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (r.result_data=jsonb_build_object('operationId',r.id,'batchId',b.id,'sequence',after_cp->'sequence','cursor',after_cp->'cursor','status',r.result_data->'status','ledgerEntryIds','[]'::jsonb)
  AND r.result_data->>'status' IN('STAGED','VALIDATING')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original six-field zero-effect initialization receipt required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY q.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO scheme_rows FROM naijue_erp.barcode_scheme q;
 IF scheme_rows IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'native' ORDER BY x->'native'->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(approved) x) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Whole scheme table must retain all exact six approved snapshots on creation and replay' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF fresh AND (b.checkpoint IS DISTINCT FROM after_cp OR r.result_data->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM b.status
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_source_row WHERE batch_id=b.id AND entity_type='BARCODE')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.sku_barcode)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'First scheme initialization precedes all barcode effects and advances only sequence' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF (b.checkpoint->>'sequence')::bigint<(after_cp->>'sequence')::bigint THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Committed scheme checkpoint cannot disappear on replay' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF b.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT id INTO STRICT birth_binding FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE target_type='IMPORT' AND target_id=b.id AND action='IMPORT_BIND_FULL_SOURCE' AND status='COMMITTED';
  PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_core_initialization_v14(b.id,birth_binding,false);
 ELSIF b.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL OR b.checkpoint->'expected'<>'{}'::jsonb THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Original unbound CORE metadata cannot be partially substituted' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.lock_category_tree_statement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- A prior repeatable snapshot cannot observe the previous directory holder.
 -- Refuse with serialization failure, never validate a stale final component.
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation')<>'read committed' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Category final-state writes require a fresh read-committed snapshot' USING ERRCODE='40001';
 END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('naijue:catalogue-maintenance',0));
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_effective_set_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE invalid boolean;
BEGIN
 WITH revisions AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT r.* FROM naijue_erp.history_revision r JOIN(SELECT DISTINCT revision_id FROM history_new) n ON r.id=n.revision_id
  WHERE r.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
 ), expected AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT r.id revision_id,r.document_kind,r.sales_id,r.transfer_id,e.value
  FROM revisions r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='history_sales_settlement_effective' THEN r.after_facts->'settlements' ELSE r.after_facts->'lines' END)e(value)
 ), actual AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT to_jsonb(n) value FROM history_new n)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM actual a LEFT JOIN expected e
  ON e.revision_id=(a.value->>'revision_id')::uuid
   AND e.value->>CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='history_sales_settlement_effective' THEN 'settlementId' ELSE 'lineId' END
    =a.value->>CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='history_sales_settlement_effective' THEN 'settlement_id' ELSE 'line_id' END
  WHERE e.revision_id IS NULL OR CASE TG_TABLE_NAME
   WHEN 'history_sales_line_effective' THEN e.document_kind<>'SALES'
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_line l WHERE l.id=(a.value->>'line_id')::uuid AND l.header_id=e.sales_id)
    OR jsonb_build_object('quantity',(a.value->>'quantity')::bigint::text,'dealPrice',(a.value->>'deal_price')::numeric(18,2)::text,'lineAmount',(a.value->>'line_amount')::numeric(18,2)::text,'allocatedDiscount',CASE WHEN a.value->'allocated_discount'='null'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE (a.value->>'allocated_discount')::numeric(18,2)::text END) IS DISTINCT FROM e.value-ARRAY['lineId','skuId']
   WHEN 'history_transfer_line_effective' THEN e.document_kind<>'TRANSFER' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revisions d WHERE d.id=e.revision_id AND d.after_facts ? 'draftLineSetVersion')
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_transfer_line l WHERE l.id=(a.value->>'line_id')::uuid AND l.header_id=e.transfer_id)
    OR (a.value->>'quantity')::bigint::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'quantity'
   WHEN 'history_sales_settlement_effective' THEN e.document_kind<>'SALES'
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.history_sales_settlement l WHERE l.id=(a.value->>'settlement_id')::uuid AND l.header_id=e.sales_id)
    OR (a.value->>'amount')::numeric(18,2)::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'amount'
   ELSE true END) INTO invalid;
 IF invalid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical projection set differs from original revision facts' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.history_numeric_ledger_set_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE invalid boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM history_new WHERE event_kind='HISTORY_REVISION') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 WITH revisions AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT r.* FROM naijue_erp.history_revision r JOIN(SELECT DISTINCT source_history_revision_id id FROM history_new WHERE event_kind='HISTORY_REVISION') n USING(id)
  WHERE r.xmin::text::bigint=mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
 ), expected AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT r.id revision_id,r.operation_id,r.document_kind,r.to_version,r.before_facts->>'businessDate' business_date,r.changed_at,e.value
   FROM revisions r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.stock_effect_evidence->'effects')e(value)
 ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM history_new n LEFT JOIN expected e ON e.revision_id=n.source_history_revision_id AND e.value->>'ledgerEntryId'=n.id::text
  WHERE n.event_kind='HISTORY_REVISION' AND (e.revision_id IS NULL OR n.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM e.operation_id
   OR n.source_document_version IS DISTINCT FROM e.to_version OR n.business_date::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.business_date OR n.posted_at IS DISTINCT FROM e.changed_at
   OR n.warehouse_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'warehouseId' OR n.sku_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'skuId'
   OR n.endpoint IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'endpoint' OR n.quantity_delta::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'quantityDelta'
   OR (e.document_kind='SALES' AND(n.source_history_sales_line_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'lineId' OR n.source_history_transfer_line_id IS NOT NULL))
   OR (e.document_kind='TRANSFER' AND(n.source_history_transfer_line_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM e.value->>'lineId' OR n.source_history_sales_line_id IS NOT NULL)))) INTO invalid;
 IF invalid THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical ledger set differs from exact current revision effects' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_document_migration(operation uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE; a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; b naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE;
 s naijue_erp.import_record%ROWTYPE; baseline naijue_erp.import_batch%ROWTYPE; snap jsonb; evidence jsonb; h jsonb; expected_type text;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=operation;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE operation_id=r.id;
 snap:=naijue_erp.unified_document_snapshot(r.target_type,r.target_id); h:=snap->'header';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=(h->>'import_batch_id')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE id=(r.result_data->>'sourceRecordId')::uuid;
 evidence:=a.after_values->'baseline';
 SELECT * INTO STRICT baseline FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE id=(evidence->>'baselineBatchId')::uuid;
 expected_type:=CASE r.target_type WHEN 'SALES' THEN 'SALES_HEADER' WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN 'TRANSFER_HEADER' END;
 IF r.action<>'MIGRATE_DOCUMENT' OR r.status<>'COMMITTED' OR r.target_type NOT IN ('SALES','TRANSFER')
  OR b.inventory_mode<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' OR b.mapping_version<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1' OR b.status NOT IN ('STAGED','VALIDATING','IMPORTED')
  OR r.result_data->>'batchId' IS DISTINCT FROM b.id::text OR s.import_batch_id<>b.id OR s.source_system<>b.source_name
  OR s.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM expected_type OR s.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.target_id OR s.status<>'IMPORTED'
  OR s.reviewed_at IS NULL OR s.source_entity_type IS DISTINCT FROM expected_type
  OR a.object_type<>r.target_type OR a.object_id<>r.target_id OR a.action<>r.action OR a.actor_account_id<>r.actor_account_id
  OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at OR a.old_version IS NOT NULL OR a.before_values IS NOT NULL
  OR a.new_version::text IS DISTINCT FROM h->>'version' OR r.result_data->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM h->>'version'
  OR r.result_data->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM h->>'status' OR r.result_data->'ledgerEntryIds'<>'[]'
  OR (a.after_values - ARRAY['baseline','sourceRecordId']) IS DISTINCT FROM snap
  OR a.after_values->>'sourceRecordId' IS DISTINCT FROM s.id::text OR r.result_data->'baseline' IS DISTINCT FROM evidence
  OR r.result_data->>'exposureDigest' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(snap::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR h->>'stock_basis'<>'CUTOFF_HISTORY' OR baseline.inventory_mode<>'CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE' OR baseline.status<>'IMPORTED'
  OR evidence->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'CONFIRMED' OR evidence->>'baselineManifestSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM baseline.source_hash
  OR (evidence->>'cutoffAt')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM baseline.cutoff_at OR b.cutoff_at IS DISTINCT FROM baseline.cutoff_at
  OR (evidence->>'coverageDigest' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR (evidence - ARRAY['state','baselineBatchId','baselineManifestSha256','cutoffAt','coverageDigest'])<>'{}' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'migration requires exact typed ordinary snapshot, source/baseline coverage, actor, version and audit' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_ledger WHERE operation_id=r.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_balance WHERE last_operation_id=r.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'migration creates no inventory effects' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 PERFORM naijue_erp.assert_unified_current_actor(r.actor_account_id,r.completed_at,r.target_type,r.target_id,r.action);
 IF baseline.mapping_version='STANDARD_INITIAL_EXPLICIT_KEYS_V1' THEN
  PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_import_identity(NULL,'ROLE_IMPORTER');
  IF NOT naijue_erp.standard_import_row_intent(expected_type,CASE r.target_type WHEN 'SALES' THEN to_jsonb(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::naijue_erp.sales_header,h)) ELSE to_jsonb(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::naijue_erp.transfer_header,h)) END) OR baseline.source_name<>b.source_name OR baseline.source_hash<>b.source_hash
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'lines') item CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT (h->>'warehouse_id')::uuid warehouse WHERE r.target_type='SALES'
     UNION ALL SELECT (h->>'from_warehouse_id')::uuid WHERE r.target_type='TRANSFER'
     UNION ALL SELECT (h->>'to_warehouse_id')::uuid WHERE r.target_type='TRANSFER') endpoint
     WHERE h->>'status'='APPROVED' AND item->>'is_current'='true' AND (item->>'quantity')::bigint<>0
       AND naijue_erp.standard_inventory_key_proof(endpoint.warehouse,(item->>'sku_id')::uuid)->>'state'='UNKNOWN') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'STANDARD_MIGRATION_EXPLICIT_ENDPOINT_COVERAGE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 -- All actual detail identities are mapped once, including zero-quantity lines and
 -- every settlement occurrence; many-to-one SKU aliases remain legal separately.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'lines') item WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record m
   WHERE m.import_batch_id=b.id AND m.status='IMPORTED' AND m.target_type=CASE r.target_type WHEN 'SALES' THEN 'SALES_LINE' ELSE 'TRANSFER_LINE' END
     AND m.source_entity_type=m.target_type AND m.target_id=(item->>'id')::uuid))
  OR (r.target_type='SALES' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'settlements') item WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record m
    WHERE m.import_batch_id=b.id AND m.status='IMPORTED' AND m.target_type='SALES_SETTLEMENT' AND m.source_entity_type=m.target_type AND m.target_id=(item->>'id')::uuid))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'migration requires complete stable detail/settlement source mappings' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.assert_document_conversion_batch(next_row naijue_erp.import_batch, prior jsonb, mutation text, final_state boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE kind text; actual bigint; total numeric:=0; a naijue_erp.audit_change%ROWTYPE; r naijue_erp.operation_receipt%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 PERFORM naijue_erp.cutoff_import_lock();
 IF final_state THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT' AND object_id=next_row.id AND new_version=(next_row.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer+1;
  IF a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' THEN PERFORM naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_context_v2((a.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation')::uuid); END IF;
 END IF;
 IF mutation='DELETE' OR next_row.inventory_mode<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION' OR next_row.mapping_version<>'DOCUMENT_CONVERSION_V1'
   OR next_row.history_payload_hash IS NOT NULL OR next_row.history_expected_counts IS NOT NULL
   OR next_row.history_actual_counts IS NOT NULL OR next_row.history_validation_passed IS TRUE
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_batch WHERE status='IMPORTED' AND inventory_mode='CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE' AND cutoff_at=next_row.cutoff_at)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.inventory_ledger WHERE source_import_batch_id=next_row.id)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt receipt_row JOIN naijue_erp.inventory_ledger l ON l.operation_id=receipt_row.id WHERE receipt_row.target_type='IMPORT' AND receipt_row.target_id=next_row.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion cannot post or rebaseline inventory; one exact previously published cutoff is required' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF mutation='INSERT' THEN
  IF next_row.status<>'STAGED' OR next_row.checkpoint->>'sequence'<>'0' OR next_row.checkpoint->>'cursor'<>'0' THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion must stage at zero' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 ELSE
  IF prior IS NULL OR prior->>'status' IN ('IMPORTED','FAILED')
    OR (to_jsonb(next_row)-ARRAY['status','checkpoint','completed_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM (prior-ARRAY['status','checkpoint','completed_at'])
    OR next_row.checkpoint->'expected' IS DISTINCT FROM prior->'checkpoint'->'expected'
    OR (next_row.checkpoint->>'sequence')::numeric<>(prior->'checkpoint'->>'sequence')::numeric+1
    OR (next_row.checkpoint->>'cursor')::numeric<(prior->'checkpoint'->>'cursor')::numeric
    OR next_row.status NOT IN ('VALIDATING','IMPORTED','FAILED') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable conversion source or invalid checkpoint/state transition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(next_row.checkpoint->'expected'))<>6
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(next_row.checkpoint->'counts'))<>6 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion requires exactly six ordinary target counters' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 FOREACH kind IN ARRAY ARRAY['SALES_HEADER','SALES_LINE','SALES_SETTLEMENT','TRANSFER_HEADER','TRANSFER_LINE','IMPORT_BATCH'] LOOP
  IF jsonb_typeof(next_row.checkpoint->'expected'->kind) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR jsonb_typeof(next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->kind) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
   OR (next_row.checkpoint->'expected'->>kind ~ '^[0-9]+$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->>kind ~ '^[0-9]+$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
   OR (next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->>kind)::numeric>(next_row.checkpoint->'expected'->>kind)::numeric
   OR (prior IS NOT NULL AND (next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->>kind)::numeric<(prior->'checkpoint'->'counts'->>kind)::numeric) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion counter type/range/monotonicity mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  total:=total+(next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->>kind)::numeric;
  IF final_state THEN
   IF a.after_values ? 'whole_package_v2' THEN
    SELECT count(*) INTO actual FROM naijue_erp.import_record source_row JOIN naijue_erp.audit_change source_audit
     ON source_audit.operation_id=(source_row.decision_reason::jsonb->>'operationId')::uuid
     WHERE source_row.import_batch_id=next_row.id AND source_row.target_type=kind AND source_row.status='IMPORTED'
      AND source_audit.object_type='IMPORT' AND source_audit.object_id=next_row.id AND source_audit.new_version<=a.new_version
      AND source_audit.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation'=a.after_values->'whole_package_v2'->>'root_operation';
   ELSE
   SELECT count(*) INTO actual FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE import_batch_id=next_row.id AND target_type=kind AND status='IMPORTED';
   END IF;
   IF actual::numeric<>(next_row.checkpoint->'counts'->>kind)::numeric THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion counters must equal exact committed ordinary identities: %',kind USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF total<>(next_row.checkpoint->>'cursor')::numeric OR next_row.checkpoint->'expected'->>'IMPORT_BATCH'<>'1' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion exact cursor/final approval scope mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT final_state THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM naijue_erp.audit_change WHERE object_type='IMPORT' AND object_id=next_row.id AND new_version=(next_row.checkpoint->>'sequence')::integer+1;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM naijue_erp.operation_receipt WHERE id=a.operation_id;
 IF (CASE WHEN r.result_data->>'profile'='STANDARD_IMPORT_SQL_V1' THEN a.after_values->'checkpoint' ELSE a.after_values END) IS DISTINCT FROM next_row.checkpoint OR a.actor_account_id<>r.actor_account_id OR a.occurred_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at
   OR r.target_type<>'IMPORT' OR r.target_id<>next_row.id OR r.result_data->>'sequence' IS DISTINCT FROM next_row.checkpoint->>'sequence'
   OR r.result_data->>'cursor' IS DISTINCT FROM next_row.checkpoint->>'cursor' OR r.result_data->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM next_row.status
   OR (mutation='INSERT' AND (a.old_version IS NOT NULL OR a.before_values IS NOT NULL OR r.action<>'IMPORT_STAGE'))
   OR (mutation='UPDATE' AND (a.old_version IS DISTINCT FROM (prior->'checkpoint'->>'sequence')::integer+1 OR a.before_values IS DISTINCT FROM prior->'checkpoint'))
   OR r.action IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE next_row.status WHEN 'STAGED' THEN 'IMPORT_STAGE' WHEN 'IMPORTED' THEN 'IMPORT_PUBLISH' ELSE 'IMPORT_CHUNK' END)
   OR r.result_data->'ledgerEntryIds'<>'[]'
   OR (next_row.status='IMPORTED' AND next_row.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM r.completed_at) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion checkpoint requires its exact atomic import audit/receipt' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.user_account ua JOIN naijue_erp.staff st ON st.id=ua.staff_id
   WHERE ua.id=r.actor_account_id AND ua.login_enabled AND st.employment_status='在职' AND st.role='ADMIN')
  OR r.completed_at IS DISTINCT FROM transaction_timestamp() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'conversion batch requires actual current administrator and transaction time' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF next_row.status='IMPORTED' THEN
  IF next_row.checkpoint->'counts' IS DISTINCT FROM next_row.checkpoint->'expected'
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record WHERE import_batch_id=next_row.id AND status NOT IN ('IMPORTED','EXCLUDED'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.guard_retained_settlement_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- INSERT ... ON CONFLICT UPDATE runs this guard before conflict resolution.
 -- Lock the canonical owner first, as ordinary DELETE/UPDATE do, so a concurrent
 -- deletion cannot turn an allowed existing-row UPSERT into retired-ID reuse.
 PERFORM 1 FROM naijue_erp.sales_header WHERE id=NEW.sales_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement canonical sales owner must exist' USING ERRCODE='23503'; END IF;
 -- Runtime identity retention is a business audit concern, not a source map read.
 IF current_user='erp_unified27_runtime_2393dbc6db9581c2' THEN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.sales_settlement WHERE id=NEW.id AND sales_id=NEW.sales_id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.audit_change a JOIN naijue_erp.operation_receipt r ON r.id=a.operation_id
     WHERE a.object_type='SALES' AND r.target_type='SALES' AND r.target_id=a.object_id
       AND r.status='COMMITTED' AND r.action=a.action AND r.actor_account_id=a.actor_account_id
       AND r.completed_at=a.occurred_at AND EXISTS(
         SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(a.before_values->'settlements','[]'::jsonb)
           ||coalesce(a.after_values->'settlements','[]'::jsonb)) item WHERE item->>'id'=NEW.id::text)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retired ordinary settlement identity cannot be recycled' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
 END IF;
 -- Import-only predecessor source checks remain unchanged.
 -- A source-bound existing row may be updated through the common SAVE path;
 -- the owner, exact before/after and same-transaction audit guards remain.
 -- A removed occurrence survives in immutable audit and cannot be resurrected.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.import_record retained_record
   WHERE retained_record.target_type='SALES_SETTLEMENT' AND retained_record.target_id=NEW.id AND retained_record.status IN ('ACCEPTED','IMPORTED')
    AND (retained_record.xmin::text::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM mod(pg_current_xact_id()::text::numeric,4294967296)::bigint
      OR naijue_erp.standard_import_row_intent('SALES_SETTLEMENT',to_jsonb(NEW)) IS DISTINCT FROM true))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM naijue_erp.sales_settlement WHERE id=NEW.id AND sales_id=NEW.sales_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retired source settlement identity cannot be recycled' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_step_v2(init_operation uuid, ordinal integer, command_phase text, request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF command_phase IS NULL OR command_phase NOT IN ('MASTER','KEYS','DOCUMENTS','PUBLISH') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'WHOLE_PHASE_ORDER_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN naijue_erp.standard_whole_package_command_v2(request,NULL,command_phase,init_operation,ordinal);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.reject_document_runtime_reference_id_update_v1()

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'

BEGIN

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Runtime reference lock must not update identity' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION naijue_erp.standard_zero_amount_archive_trace(sales uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(record_id uuid, sales_id uuid, sales_source_key text, source_namespace text, proof jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'naijue_erp', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role') IS DISTINCT FROM 'erp_unified27_importer_2393dbc6db9581c2' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'ZERO_ARCHIVE_IMPORTER_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT s.id,s.target_id,s.source_key,s.source_system,
  naijue_erp.standard_import_record_proof(s.id)
 FROM naijue_erp.import_record s
 JOIN naijue_erp.sales_header h ON h.id=s.target_id AND h.import_batch_id=s.import_batch_id
 JOIN naijue_erp.import_batch b ON b.id=s.import_batch_id AND b.status='IMPORTED'
 WHERE s.target_type='SALES_HEADER' AND s.status='IMPORTED' AND s.target_id=sales
  AND h.stock_basis='CUTOFF_HISTORY' AND h.business_type='SALE';
END $function$
